block.nuclearsq.acid_plant_controller_sq: Controller of the acid plant: a part for its machine kit. In the finished plant right-clicking it opens the terminal, and data cables can be attached here.
block.nuclearsq.active_cooler_sqc.info: Cooler tier 2: +0.6 cooling per tick on the control rod drive (right-click the controller). Required from the fluorite moderator on.
block.nuclearsq.airlock_control_sqc.info: Couples the two nearest door controllers within 12 blocks into an airlock: only one door is ever open. Right-click opens the terminal, sneak + right-click or a redstone pulse cycles it (open door closes, chamber is purged, other door opens).
block.nuclearsq.airlock_door_panel_sqc.i: Building block for an airlock door. A rectangle (for example 2×3) becomes a pressure-tight door with frame, handwheel and porthole whose leaf slides aside in one piece. Sneak + left-click builds the door, right-clicking the door or a redstone signal next to it drives it, no control block needed. Two of them and an airlock controller make an airlock.
block.nuclearsq.area_monitor_sqc.info: Measures the dose rate at its spot every second (wall, ceiling or floor). Above the threshold: red lamp and redstone 15. Right-click shows value, peak and threshold, sneaking resets the peak. Also reports its values to the data network.
block.nuclearsq.area_sensor_sqc.info: Measures a whole radius once per second (8 blocks by default) and reports the peak, the average and the hottest spot. Lamp, redstone and controls like the Spot Radiation Sensor, radius settable via the data network or ComputerCraft.
block.nuclearsq.auction_monitor_sqc.info: App monitor for real auctions with bids. Logged in at the Login Monitor you put the item in your hand up with a starting price, an optional buyout and a duration. Others bid with coins from their bank account, digital only. The highest bid at the end wins. Items are collected where they were put up or bid on: at the same Auction Monitor. Like the Bank Terminal it needs a connection to the Bank Server.
block.nuclearsq.bank_modem_sqc.info: Connects terminal and server without cables or range: put one modem next to the Bank Terminal and one next to the Bank Server and they find each other in the same world network. A computer at the modem operates the terminal beside it.
block.nuclearsq.bank_server_sqc.info: Brings the bank online: accounts, transfers, loans and auction offers live on the server and cannot be changed by programs. Place it right next to a Bank Terminal or put a Bank Modem beside it. Right-click shows the number of accounts and offers.
block.nuclearsq.bank_terminal_sqc.info: Right-click logs you in and opens the container: put coins in to deposit and items in for the auction house, payouts and bought items come out here. Sneak + right-click logs out. A computer next to it operates the bank through the sqc_bank peripheral (SQ-OS: Bank and Auction House apps). A modem next to the terminal connects it to the server.
block.nuclearsq.battery_large_controller: Controller of the large battery: a part for its machine kit. In the finished machine right-clicking it opens the terminal, and data cables can be attached here.
block.nuclearsq.battery_medium_controlle: Controller of the medium battery: a part for its machine kit. In the finished machine right-clicking it opens the terminal, and data cables can be attached here.
block.nuclearsq.battery_small_controller: Controller of the small battery: a part for its machine kit. In the finished machine right-clicking it opens the terminal, and data cables can be attached here.
block.nuclearsq.big_pipe_sqc.info: Straight water pipe, 2×2 blocks thick and octagonal. A right-click places four blocks in the direction of the clicked face, at a large pipe port it aligns itself. No corners: straight runs only, 640 mB/t per quarter. Breaking it removes the whole piece.
block.nuclearsq.blast_furnace_controller: Control block of the blast furnace. It sits in the finished machine: right-click opens the terminal, and data cables can be attached here.
block.nuclearsq.borax_ore_sqc.info: Drops borax (Fortune works) and experience. Between Y -16 and 48, needs a stone pickaxe. Borax becomes boric acid in the boric acid plant.
block.nuclearsq.boric_acid_plant_control: Controller of the boric acid plant: a part for its machine kit. In the finished plant right-clicking it opens the terminal, and data cables can be attached here.
block.nuclearsq.cable_basic_sqc.info: Power cable up to 4,096 FE/t. Sticks to floor, wall or ceiling and connects by itself to anything that stores power. Power goes to all devices at the same time.
block.nuclearsq.cable_hardened_sqc.info: Power cable up to 524,288 FE/t, made from reinforced cables with rubber insulation. For turbines, batteries and large plants.
block.nuclearsq.cable_reinforced_sqc.inf: Power cable up to 32,768 FE/t, made from basic cables. Laid like the basic cable.
block.nuclearsq.cable_superconductor_sqc: Power cable up to 33,554,432 FE/t, made from hardened cables and a superconducting coil. Carries the power shot of the fusion reactor.
block.nuclearsq.cage_door_panel_sqc.info: Building block for a cage door. A rectangle up to 15×15 becomes a thin door of frame and wire mesh that you can see through. From 2 blocks wide it has two leaves, it needs room in front to swing open. Sneak + left-click builds the door, right-clicking the door or a redstone signal next to it drives it.
block.nuclearsq.castor_large_sqc.info: Large transport cask for spent rods and cooled spent fuel. The contents do not radiate and stay inside when broken. Right-click with a rod to insert, empty hand shows the contents, Shift + right-click with an empty hand picks up the whole cask with its contents.
block.nuclearsq.chemical_lab_controller_: Controller of the chemical lab: a part for its machine kit. In the finished plant right-clicking it opens the terminal, and data cables can be attached here.
block.nuclearsq.clean_room_controller_sq: Controller of the clean room. It sits in the finished machine: right-click opens the terminal, and data cables can be attached here.
Control block of the CNC mill. It sits in the finished machine: right-click opens the terminal, and data cables can be attached here.
block.nuclearsq.coal_generator_controlle: Controller of the coal generator. It sits in the finished machine: right-clicking it opens the terminal, and data cables can be attached here. The machine itself comes as a kit from the crafting table.
block.nuclearsq.cold_door_panel_sqc.info: Building block for a cold room door. A rectangle up to 15×15 becomes a thick white door with a seal, a large lever handle and a temperature display. From 2 blocks wide it has two leaves, it needs room in front to swing open. Sneak + left-click builds the door, right-clicking the door or a redstone signal next to it drives it.
block.nuclearsq.component_assembler_cont: Controller of the Component Assembler. It sits in the finished machine: right-clicking the monitor or the controller opens the menu, and data cables can be attached here or at a port. Made in the Reactor Assembler.
block.nuclearsq.compute_assembler_contro: Controller of the compute assembler. It sits in the finished machine: right-click opens the 3×3 grid like the reactor assembler. Its speed depends on the free computing power in the data network.
block.nuclearsq.compute_cluster_controll: Controller of the computing cluster as a machine: a part for its machine kit. In the finished cluster, right-click shows its state. The machine gives the data network a fixed 32 CPU cores and 512 GB RAM, needs 780 FE/t and cooling water.
block.nuclearsq.condenser_controller_sqc: Controller of the large condenser: a part for its machine kit. In the finished machine right-clicking it opens the terminal, and data cables can be attached here.
block.nuclearsq.condenser_sqc.info: Part for the large condenser and the relief tank (kits from the Heavy Assembler).
block.nuclearsq.conduit_frame_sqc.info: Wall feed-through for cables, pipes, item pipes and data cables. Right-click with a conduit to insert it, right-click with a full block to give the frame its look. Sneaking with an empty hand removes the look again.
block.nuclearsq.containment_controller_s: Controller of the containment: a part for its machine kit. In the finished machine right-clicking it opens the terminal, sneak + right-click opens and closes the bunker door, and data cables can be attached here.
block.nuclearsq.contamination_monitor_sq: Checks everyone up to 2 blocks in front of it at the airlock every second, body and inventory. Above 10 µSv/h: red lamp, beeping and redstone 15, for example to keep a door shut.
block.nuclearsq.control_desk_controller_: Controller of the control desk: a part for its machine kit. In the finished machine right-clicking it opens the terminal, and data cables can be attached here.
block.nuclearsq.control_rod_drive_contro: Controller of the fuel rod drive: a part for its machine kit. In the finished machine right-clicking it opens the terminal, and data cables can be attached here.
block.nuclearsq.control_wall_sqc.info: Building block of the control room wall: 3×2 to 5×3 screens as a full rectangle. Every plant on the network gets a tile, right-clicking a tile opens its terminal.
block.nuclearsq.cooling_tower_closed_sqc: Closed cooling tower segment, top tier.
block.nuclearsq.cooling_tower_hardened_s: Hardened cooling tower segment, third tier.
block.nuclearsq.cooling_tower_large_cont: Controller of the cooling tower: a part for its machine kit. In the finished machine right-clicking it opens the terminal, and data cables can be attached here.
block.nuclearsq.cooling_tower_plated_sqc: Cooling tower segment with osmium heat plates, second tier.
block.nuclearsq.cooling_tower_segment_sq: First-tier cooling tower segment, part of the cooling tower kits.
block.nuclearsq.cooling_tower_xl_control: Controller of the cooling tower XL: a part for its machine kit. In the finished machine right-clicking it opens the terminal, and data cables can be attached here.
block.nuclearsq.cracker_controller_sqc.i: Control block of the machine. It sits in the finished machine: right-click opens the terminal, and data cables can be attached here.
block.nuclearsq.crafting_terminal_sqc.in: Storage terminal with a 3×3 crafting grid on the data cable. Shows every rack on the network and crafts straight from storage: used ingredients are refilled from the racks, shift-click on the result crafts as often as possible, and whatever is in the grid when you close it goes back to the network. Needs no power itself, but 2 CPU and 32 GB RAM on the network.
Create only: place it right at the turbine's exhaust ring on the rotor axis (or behind a shaft coupling), outputs its power as rotation (up to 256 RPM). Create shafts at the front take the rotation.
block.nuclearsq.creative_energy_source_s: Creative testing only: pushes unlimited power to all six neighbours every tick. Place it right against a power port.
block.nuclearsq.creative_fluid_source_sq: Creative testing only: supplies water to all neighbours. Right-click with a filled bucket to switch to that fluid, empty hand shows what it supplies.
block.nuclearsq.cryo_cooling_core_sqc.in: Cooler tier 3: +1.0 cooling per tick on the control rod drive (right-click the controller). Reserve for the fluorite moderator.
block.nuclearsq.data_bar_sqc.info: Wall display with a bar and percentage for one value of a plant. Controls like the needle gauge.
block.nuclearsq.data_button_sqc.info: Wall button for the data network: triggers an action of a plant (emergency stop, empty a tank, reset the peak) or switches it on and off. Sneak + right-click picks plant and action, right-click presses. Gives a short redstone 15 when pressed.
block.nuclearsq.data_cable_sqc.info: Connects plants to terminals, the console, instruments, the control room and the control desk. Lay it on floors, walls or ceilings like a power cable and attach it to a controller, a port of a large machine or straight to a single machine. The wrench disconnects a side.
block.nuclearsq.data_console_sqc.info: Command line for every plant on the network: list, info, get, set, watch and open. A part of the name works instead of the number.
block.nuclearsq.data_display_sqc.info: Large digital display for one value of a plant. Controls like the needle gauge.
block.nuclearsq.data_gauge_sqc.info: Wall gauge with a needle and red zone for one value of a plant. Right-click picks the next value, sneaking the next plant, a comparator reads it as 0-15.
block.nuclearsq.data_lever_sqc.info: Wall lever for the data network: switches an on/off value of a plant (operation, manual mode, terminal control, lock a shaft). Sneak + right-click picks plant and value, right-click flips it. Follows the real state and gives redstone 15 when up.
block.nuclearsq.data_logbook_sqc.info: Records events of the plants on the data network with a timestamp: alarms, warnings, all-clears, on and off, plant linked or lost. The latest entries are drawn right on the screen in the world like a ComputerCraft monitor, the newest at the bottom. Several blocks side by side make a big screen (up to 4 x 4). Right-click opens the full book, the last 500 stay in the block. With CC:Tweaked it is the peripheral sqc_logbook.
block.nuclearsq.data_multi_sqc.info: Wall display for four values of one plant as a list, with name and status lamp. Right-click opens the window: arrows or mouse wheel pick the plant and the value of each row. Needs a data cable to the plant.
block.nuclearsq.data_power_sqc.info: Shows how much power the plants on the data network produce and consume: a graph of the last minutes, plus balance, storage level and a forecast of how long the storage lasts. The graph is drawn right on the screen in the world like a ComputerCraft monitor; several blocks side by side make a big screen (up to 4 x 4). Right-click opens the window with all values and the biggest consumers, sneak + right-click switches the graph on the screen between seconds and half an hour. With CC:Tweaked it is the peripheral sqc_power.
block.nuclearsq.data_slider_sqc.info: Wall slider for the data network: sets a value with a range (rod target, throttle, channel, radius) in 16 steps. Sneak + right-click picks plant and value, right-click on the track sets the step. Gives its step as redstone 0-15.
block.nuclearsq.data_terminal_sqc.info: Shows every plant on the network as a folder to expand: live values, switches and steps, and for server racks the bays with drives and items. Filters, search (also for items on the drives), locate and each plant's own terminal. With CC:Tweaked it is the peripheral sqc_network.
block.nuclearsq.decon_dock_controller_sq: Controller of the decon dock: a part for its machine kit. In the finished plant right-clicking the monitor at the front right (seen from the front) opens the terminal, and data cables can be attached to the data port.
block.nuclearsq.decon_shower_sqc.info: Shower for the exit of your reactor hall. Hang it from the ceiling and give it water (pipe, bucket or water above). Anyone below loses four fifths of their contamination every second, it does not lower the dose.
Drops borax (Fortune works) and experience. Between Y -16 and 48, needs a stone pickaxe. Borax becomes boric acid in the boric acid plant.
block.nuclearsq.deepslate_fluorite_ore_s: Drops fluorite gems (Fortune works) and experience. Deep down, from Y 16 down. Also comes out of the particle assembler.
block.nuclearsq.deepslate_lead_ore_sqc.i: Drops raw lead (Fortune works). Common between Y -32 and 64. Also comes out of the particle assembler.
block.nuclearsq.deepslate_lithium_ore_sq: Ore with lithium for the fusion reactor. Spawns in every world, from Y -32 to 64.
block.nuclearsq.deepslate_osmium_ore_sqc: Drops raw osmium (Fortune works). Between Y -48 and 64, needs an iron pickaxe. Also comes out of the particle assembler.
block.nuclearsq.deepslate_tin_ore_sqc.in: Drops raw tin (Fortune works). Very common, up to Y 96. Also comes out of the particle assembler.
block.nuclearsq.deepslate_uranium_ore_sq: Drops raw uranium (Fortune works). Found deep, from Y 48 down, needs an iron pickaxe. Also comes out of the particle assembler.
block.nuclearsq.deepslate_zircon_ore_sqc: Drops zircon (Fortune works) and experience. Deep down, from Y 32 down, needs an iron pickaxe. Always generates, no other mod supplies zircon. Also comes out of the particle assembler.
block.nuclearsq.deuterium_separator_cont: Controller of the deuterium separator: a part for its machine kit. In the finished machine right-clicking it opens the terminal, and data cables connect here.
block.nuclearsq.distillation_column_cont: Control block of the machine. It sits in the finished machine: right-click opens the terminal, and data cables can be attached here.
block.nuclearsq.door_control_sqc.info: An accessory for doors made of panels, which also work without it: placed directly against a door it shows state, kind and size in the terminal and makes the door remote-controllable on a data cable. Right-click opens the terminal, sneak + right-click drives the door at once, a redstone signal opens it.
block.nuclearsq.drone_item_port_sqc.info: Data network device: gives the nano bots access to the digital storage. Place it on a data cable (or right at a server rack), right-click it with the Nano Swarm Canister to couple (sneak + right-click releases the coupling). In the gadget menu (tab GADGET, source PORT) the bots take building material from the storage; the port needs no power, the racks in the network do. Only works in the same dimension and up to 64 blocks away (config portRange).
block.nuclearsq.electrolyzer_controller_: Controller of the electrolyzer: a part for its machine kit. In the finished machine right-clicking it opens the terminal, and data cables can be attached here.
block.nuclearsq.emergency_cooling_contro: Controller of the emergency cooling: a part for its machine kit. In the finished machine right-clicking it opens the terminal, and data cables can be attached here.
Switch cabinet, 2 blocks tall. Place it right against a machine with recipes: 20 % less power per cabinet, at most 2.
block.nuclearsq.enrichment_centrifuge_co: Controller of the enrichment centrifuge: a part for its machine kit. In the finished machine right-clicking it opens the terminal, and data cables can be attached here.
block.nuclearsq.equipment_assembler_cont: Control block of the equipment assembler. It sits in the finished machine: right-click opens the terminal, and data cables can be attached here.
block.nuclearsq.exo_station_controller_s: Control block of the Exo Station. It sits in the finished chamber: right-click with an exo piece lays it inside, with an empty hand it opens the window for core and modules. Data cables can be attached here.
block.nuclearsq.fan_module_sqc.info: Half a block. Place it right against a machine with recipes: it cools one overclock module there. No effect on its own.
block.nuclearsq.fast_breeder_controller_: Controller of the fast breeder: a part for its machine kit. In the finished plant right-clicking it opens the terminal, and data cables can be attached here.
block.nuclearsq.feedwater_heater_control: Controller of the feedwater heater: a part for its machine kit. In the finished machine right-clicking it opens the terminal, and data cables can be attached here.
block.nuclearsq.feedwater_pump_controlle: Controller of the large feedwater pump: a part for its machine kit. In the finished machine right-clicking it opens the terminal, and data cables can be attached here.
block.nuclearsq.feedwater_pump_sqc.info: Part for the large feedwater pump (kit from the Heavy Assembler).
block.nuclearsq.fluid_buffer_controller_: Control block of the machine. It sits in the finished machine: right-click opens the terminal, and data cables can be attached here.
block.nuclearsq.fluorite_ore_sqc.info: Drops fluorite gems (Fortune works) and experience. Deep down, from Y 16 down. Also comes out of the particle assembler.
block.nuclearsq.folding_door_panel_sqc.i: Building block for a folding door. A rectangle up to 15×15 becomes a yellow door of vertical slats that fold up like bellows to both sides. It needs no room above or beside the door. Sneak + left-click builds the door, right-clicking the door or a redstone signal next to it drives it.
block.nuclearsq.foundry_controller_sqc.i: Controller of the foundry: a part for its machine kit. In the finished plant right-clicking it opens the terminal, and data cables can be attached here.
block.nuclearsq.fuel_cell_controller_sqc: Controller of the fuel cell: a part for its machine kit. In the finished plant right-clicking it opens the terminal, and data cables can be attached here.
block.nuclearsq.fuel_rod_block_experimen: Fuel rod casing, tier 4 (tier 3 plus atomic hull plates and plutonium). Needs an experimental docker on top.
block.nuclearsq.fuel_rod_block_hardened_: Fuel rod casing, tier 3 (tier 2 plus lead and HDPE). Needs a hardened docker on top.
block.nuclearsq.fuel_rod_block_reinforce: Fuel rod casing, tier 2 (tier 1 plus steel and osmium). Needs a reinforced docker on top.
block.nuclearsq.fuel_rod_block_sqc.info: Fuel rod casing, tier 1. Stack several, put a docker of the same tier on top, then the rod goes onto the clamp frame of a fuel rod drive.
block.nuclearsq.fuel_rod_head_experiment: Fuel rod docker, tier 4. Only fits on experimental casings.
block.nuclearsq.fuel_rod_head_hardened_s: Fuel rod docker, tier 3. Only fits on hardened casings.
block.nuclearsq.fuel_rod_head_reinforced: Fuel rod docker, tier 2. Only fits on reinforced casings.
block.nuclearsq.fuel_rod_head_sqc.info: Fuel rod docker, tier 1. Sits on top of casings of the same tier and completes the rod. If casings are missing, a message says how many.
block.nuclearsq.fusion_reactor_controlle: Controller of the fusion reactor: a part for its machine kit. In the finished machine right-clicking it opens the terminal, and data cables connect here.
block.nuclearsq.future_chest_sqc.info: Portable chest with 32 slots and three upgrade slots (capacity, magnet, sorter). In your inventory it is just a small cube. When you place it, the cube flies out and unfolds into the big chest within a second. Breaking it, or Shift + right-click with an empty hand, turns it back into the cube and keeps the contents. A quantum chest does not fit inside another chest.
block.nuclearsq.gas_generator_controller: Control block of the machine. It sits in the finished machine: right-click opens the terminal, and data cables can be attached here.
block.nuclearsq.glass_door_panel_sqc.inf: Building block for a glass door. A rectangle up to 15×15 becomes a thin door with an aluminium frame, a large glass pane and a push bar that swings open on its hinges. From 2 blocks wide it has two leaves, it needs room in front to swing open. Sneak + left-click builds the door, right-clicking the door or a redstone signal next to it drives it.
block.nuclearsq.grille_door_panel_sqc.in: Building block for a roller grille. A rectangle up to 15×15 becomes a grille with roller box and warning bar that rolls up. You can see through it, but closed nobody gets through. Sneak + left-click builds the door, right-clicking the door or a redstone signal next to it drives it.
block.nuclearsq.hammer_mill_controller_s: Control block of the hammer mill. It sits in the finished machine: right-click opens the terminal, and data cables can be attached here.
block.nuclearsq.hangar_door_panel_sqc.in: Building block for a roller door. A rectangle up to 15×15 becomes a hangar door with roller box, guide rails and a slatted curtain that quickly rolls up. Sneak + left-click builds the door, right-clicking the door or a redstone signal next to it drives it, no control block needed. Built lying flat it becomes a floor hatch.
block.nuclearsq.heat_exchanger_sqc.info: Cooler tier 1 and a part for cooling and steam machines. Right-click the control rod drive controller to install it as extra cooling (+0.3 cooling per tick). Required from the obsidian moderator on.
block.nuclearsq.heavy_assembler_controll: Controller of the Heavy Assembler: a part for its machine kit. In the finished machine right-clicking it opens the terminal, and data cables can be attached here.
block.nuclearsq.heavy_robot_arm_sqc.info: Like the robot arm, but reach 5 blocks, twice as fast (every half second) and a higher power draw. Set the amount per move with upgrades: 1, 4, 16, 32, 64. Docks to the clean room like the robot arm.
block.nuclearsq.heavy_water_plant_contro: Controller of the heavy water plant: a part for its machine kit. In the finished plant right-clicking it opens the terminal, and data cables can be attached here.
block.nuclearsq.high_pressure_injection_: Controller of the high-pressure injection: a part for its machine kit. In the finished machine right-clicking it opens the terminal, and data cables can be attached here.
block.nuclearsq.high_pressure_pump_contr: Controller of the high-pressure main coolant pump: a part for its machine kit. In the finished machine right-clicking it opens the terminal, and data cables can be attached here.
block.nuclearsq.image_monitor_sqc.info: Flat screen for pixel images from ComputerCraft. Several side by side and on top of each other (same direction, full rectangle, up to 8×8) form one big screen. Right-click sends a touch to the computer, sneak + right-click (empty hand) opens the screen with mouse and keyboard, Ctrl + right-click switches the resolution. Peripheral: sqc_image_monitor.
block.nuclearsq.industrial_door_panel_sq: Building block for an industrial roller door. A rectangle up to 15×15 becomes a galvanised roller door with a light band of small windows and a drive on the roller box that rolls up. Sneak + left-click builds the door, right-clicking the door or a redstone signal next to it drives it.
block.nuclearsq.intake_pump_controller_s: Control block of the intake pump: a part for its machine kit. In the finished machine right-clicking it opens the terminal, and data cables can be attached here.
block.nuclearsq.ion_exchanger_controller: Controller of the ion exchanger: a part for its machine kit. In the finished plant right-clicking it opens the terminal, and data cables can be attached here.
block.nuclearsq.item_pipe_basic_sqc.info: Item pipe up to 16 items per second. Connects by itself to item ports, chests and hoppers and hands items to machines first.
block.nuclearsq.item_pipe_hardened_sqc.i: Item pipe up to 256 items per second, made from reinforced item pipes. For ore mill, centrifuge and reprocessing in a row.
block.nuclearsq.item_pipe_reinforced_sqc: Item pipe up to 64 items per second, made from basic item pipes. With the wrench a side pulls from a chest.
block.nuclearsq.item_port_sqc.info: Flat plate for chests and other inventories (barrel, furnace, machine). Put it against the side of the inventory and connect it to the storage network with a data cable. Import: everything in the inventory moves into the racks (with a filter only the chosen items). Export: the filter items come out of the racks into the inventory, everything without a filter. Right-click without an item opens the window with mode, on/off, status and 5 filter slots. Right-click with an item adds or removes a filter entry, sneak + right-click clears the filter. Up to 64 items per second, a redstone signal pauses it. Robot arms and hoppers can use the port itself as input and output of the storage network. Needs no power, the racks on the network do.
block.nuclearsq.kiln_controller_sqc.info: Control block of the kiln. It sits in the finished machine: right-click opens the terminal, and data cables can be attached here.
block.nuclearsq.lab_door_panel_sqc.info: Building block for a lab door. A rectangle up to 15×15 becomes a thin white door with a narrow vision panel, kick plate and lever handle that swings open on its hinges. From 2 blocks wide it has two leaves, it needs room in front to swing open. Sneak + left-click builds the door, right-clicking the door or a redstone signal next to it drives it.
block.nuclearsq.leaching_plant_controlle: Controller of the leaching plant: a part for its machine kit. In the finished plant right-clicking it opens the terminal, and data cables can be attached here.
block.nuclearsq.lead_block_sqc.info: The strongest radiation shielding, made from 34 lead ingots. For walls around reactors and storage.
block.nuclearsq.lead_glass_sqc.info: See-through shielding that blocks as well as steel. For windows in reactor walls.
block.nuclearsq.lead_ore_sqc.info: Drops raw lead (Fortune works). Common between Y -32 and 64. Also comes out of the particle assembler.
block.nuclearsq.lift_door_panel_sqc.info: Building block for a lift gate. A rectangle up to 15×15 becomes a heavy ribbed steel plate that rises on cables in one piece. It needs as much free room above the door as the door is tall. Sneak + left-click builds the door, right-clicking the door or a redstone signal next to it drives it.
block.nuclearsq.lithium_ore_sqc.info: Ore with lithium for the fusion reactor. Spawns in every world, from Y -32 to 64.
block.nuclearsq.login_monitor_sqc.info: The first app monitor: this is where you log in with a password. On the first right-click you create your account, after that you log in with the password. The login is valid at all app monitors until you log out, leave the server or use no app monitor for 10 minutes. Sneak + right-click logs out. Like the Bank Terminal it needs a connection to the Bank Server (Bank Modem next to it or right at the server). No ComputerCraft needed.
block.nuclearsq.machine_port_acid_sqc.in: Port for acid: sulfuric acid on leaching plant and acid plant, hydrofluoric acid on the acid plant and the UF6 conversion. Right-click an acid bucket or feed or collect by pipe. Right-click with an empty hand shows name and purpose.
block.nuclearsq.machine_port_big_water_s: Port for a large pipe: four ports together form a 2×2 field. Only large pipes dock here, small pipes and hoppers do not. Right-click with an empty hand shows name and purpose.
block.nuclearsq.machine_port_coolant_sqc: Coolant port of the large machines, for example on the large pumps and the condenser. Right-click with an empty hand shows its name and job.
Power port of the large machines. Sits at its fixed spot in the kit, right-click with an empty hand shows its name and job.
block.nuclearsq.machine_port_feedwater_s: Feedwater port of the large machines. Right-click with an empty hand shows its name and job.
block.nuclearsq.machine_port_gas_sqc.inf: Port for gases: deuterium, tritium and helium in the fusion cycle, ethylene at the cracker and the gas generator. The gases have no bucket, they only flow through pipes, tanks and machines. Right-click with an empty hand shows name and purpose.
block.nuclearsq.machine_port_high_voltag: High-voltage port. Currently not needed by any plant: the substation hands its power out directly at its power outputs.
block.nuclearsq.machine_port_item_sqc.in: Item port of the large machines: yellow takes items in (hopper on top), copper-orange hands out once per second to chests, hoppers and pipes next to it.
block.nuclearsq.machine_port_primary_sqc: Port for the primary loop of the pressurized water reactor: cold or hot primary water. Primary water has no bucket, it only flows through pipes, tanks and the machines of the primary loop. Hot primary water is slightly radioactive. Right-click with an empty hand shows name and purpose.
Redstone port: controls a plant with a 0-15 signal or outputs a value, such as the power of the fuel rod drive. Right-click with an empty hand shows its job.
block.nuclearsq.machine_port_steam_sqc.i: Steam port of the large machines. Right-click with an empty hand shows its name and job.
block.nuclearsq.machine_port_terminal_sq: Terminal port on the fuel rod drive: right-click opens the terminal, ComputerCraft connects here too (sqc_reactor).
block.nuclearsq.machine_port_water_sqc.i: Water port of the large machines. Pipes on the right side, then nothing mixes. Right-click with an empty hand shows its name and job.
block.nuclearsq.machine_port_wet_steam_s: Wet steam port of the steam generator, steam separator and steam dryer. Right-click with an empty hand shows its name and job.
block.nuclearsq.main_coolant_pump_contro: Controller of the main coolant pump: a part for its machine kit. In the finished machine right-clicking it opens the terminal, and data cables can be attached here.
block.nuclearsq.micro_assembler_controll: Controller of the micro assembler. It sits in the finished machine: right-click opens the terminal, and data cables can be attached here.
block.nuclearsq.moderator_carbon_sqc.inf: Moderator tier 2: power ×1.5 with more heat. The base cooling is just enough. Install by right-clicking the control rod drive controller, shift + empty hand removes it.
block.nuclearsq.moderator_coal_sqc.info: Moderator tier 1. Right-click the control rod drive controller to install it: power ×1.25, burn-up grows by the same ratio so the energy per fuel stays the same. Works with the base cooling. Shift + right-click with an empty hand takes it out.
block.nuclearsq.moderator_fluorite_sqc.i: Moderator tier 4: power ×3 with a lot of heat. Needs at least an active cooler on the drive (the cryo core adds reserve), otherwise the core overheats.
block.nuclearsq.moderator_heavy_water_sq: Moderator tier 5, the best: power ×4 with heat ×4.2, more power per heat than the tiers before. Needs a strong cooler (cryo core) on the drive, otherwise the core overheats. Right-click the control rod drive controller.
block.nuclearsq.moderator_obsidian_sqc.i: Moderator tier 3: power ×2 with much more heat. Needs at least a heat exchanger on the drive, otherwise the core overheats. Shields radiation like concrete.
block.nuclearsq.net_pipe_adapter_sqc.inf: Connects the storage network to item pipes. Data cable into the blue socket at the back, item pipe on the yellow flange at the front. Demand: reads the recipe pattern of the machine at the end of the pipe and sends exactly the missing ingredients in recipe ratio from the network. Store: everything a pipe pushes in goes straight into the network. No buffer, no power, as fast as the pipe (16, 64 or 256 per second). Right-click opens the window, the wrench turns it. Export: sends up to 5 filter items from the network into the pipe.
block.nuclearsq.nether_sulfur_ore_sqc.in: Drops 2 to 4 sulfur dust (Fortune works) and some experience. Only in the Nether inside netherrack, between Y 10 and 117. Any pickaxe works.
block.nuclearsq.nuclear_ash_sqc.info: Ash from explosions and reprocessing. It does not radiate and can be placed as a block.
block.nuclearsq.nuclear_bomb_large_sqc.i: Stronger nuclear bomb as a multiblock, built from the Nuclear Bomb and a weapons plutonium core. Armed the same way as the small one, but the crater is much bigger.
block.nuclearsq.nuclear_bomb_sqc.info: The smallest nuclear bomb. The blast clears the crater down to bedrock, followed by a mushroom cloud, ash and radiation. Keep your distance and back up the world first.
block.nuclearsq.nuclear_bomb_tsar_sqc.in: The biggest bomb in the mod, built from the Large Nuclear Bomb and weapons plutonium cores. Only detonate it from far away and with a backed-up world.
block.nuclearsq.oil_derrick_controller_s: Control block of the machine. It sits in the finished machine: right-click opens the terminal, and data cables can be attached here.
block.nuclearsq.oil_well_sqc.info: Natural crude oil spring: a core holding the supply, surrounded by dark oil stains. Only generates with the world (one well per 16 chunks), as Small (2 million mB), Medium (6 million), Large (12 million) or Huge (24 million), each ±15 %. Right-click shows class and fill level. An empty well slowly refills (1 % of its maximum per Minecraft day). Cannot be mined in survival.
Controller of the ore mill: a part for its machine kit. In the finished machine right-clicking it opens the terminal, and data cables can be attached here.
block.nuclearsq.osmium_ore_sqc.info: Drops raw osmium (Fortune works). Between Y -48 and 64, needs an iron pickaxe. Also comes out of the particle assembler.
block.nuclearsq.overclock_module_sqc.inf: Place it right against a machine with recipes: 25 % faster per module but 40 % more power, at most 2. Each one needs a fan module on the same machine, otherwise it overheats and does nothing.
block.nuclearsq.particle_assembler_contr: Controller of the Particle Assembler: a part for its machine kit. In the finished machine right-clicking it opens the terminal, and data cables can be attached here.
block.nuclearsq.pattern_rack_controller_: Controller of the pattern rack. It sits in the finished rack: right-click opens the 40 card bays. Put written pattern cards from the component assembler in here.
block.nuclearsq.pellet_factory_controlle: Controller of the fuel pellet factory: a part for its machine kit. In the finished plant right-clicking it opens the terminal, and data cables can be attached here.
block.nuclearsq.perforated_door_panel_sq: Building block for a perforated roller door. A rectangle up to 15×15 becomes a roller door of perforated slats that you can partly see through, and it rolls up. Sneak + left-click builds the door, right-clicking the door or a redstone signal next to it drives it.
block.nuclearsq.pipe_basic_sqc.info: Pipe for any fluid, up to 1,000 mB/t, one fluid at a time. Connects by itself to ports, tanks and machines.
block.nuclearsq.pipe_hardened_sqc.info: Pipe up to 16,000 mB/t, made from reinforced pipes. A line's throughput is set by its weakest piece.
block.nuclearsq.pipe_reinforced_sqc.info: Pipe up to 4,000 mB/t, made from basic pipes. Use the wrench to set each side to pulling or disconnected.
block.nuclearsq.plate_mill_controller_sq: Control block of the plate mill. It sits in the finished machine: right-click opens the terminal, and data cables can be attached here.
block.nuclearsq.polymer_plant_controller: Controller of the polymer plant: a part for its machine kit. In the finished plant right-clicking it opens the terminal, and data cables can be attached here.
block.nuclearsq.power_gate_sqc.info: Goes between two cables and separates the network behind it from the one in front. Power enters at the back (blue) and leaves at the front (green); right-click opens the terminal with throughput limit and charge and release thresholds, the wrench turns it.
block.nuclearsq.power_mast_large_sqc.inf: Twice as large pylon for long distances: up to 256 blocks to the next large pylon, up to 64 blocks to small pylons and substations. It takes no power itself. Look along the line when placing it so the cross arms face the right way.
block.nuclearsq.power_mast_sqc.info: High-voltage pylon for the overhead line, up to 64 blocks apart. It takes no power itself. Look along the line when placing it so the cross arms face the right way.
block.nuclearsq.powergrid_terminal_sqc.i: Create: Power Grid only: grid terminal placed right at a power output of the substation. The substation fills its buffer and it feeds that into the circuit on its poles as a voltage source. Cables cannot charge it.
block.nuclearsq.pressure_chamber_experim: Top-tier pressure chamber. Plain component without an effect of its own.
block.nuclearsq.pressure_chamber_hardene: Third-tier pressure chamber. Part for the experimental pressure chamber.
block.nuclearsq.pressure_chamber_reinfor: Second-tier pressure chamber. Goes into the reprocessing facility kit.
block.nuclearsq.pressure_chamber_sqc.inf: First-tier pressure chamber, holds system pressure. Goes into the turbine kit.
block.nuclearsq.pressurizer_controller_s: Controller of the pressurizer: a part for its machine kit. In the finished machine right-clicking it opens the terminal, and data cables can be attached here.
block.nuclearsq.pump_basic_sqc.info: Smallest pump, now only a part: goes into the emergency cooling, the feedwater pump and the electric pump. The large pumps now cool the core.
block.nuclearsq.pump_electric_sqc.info: Electric pump, a part for the emergency cooling, the large feedwater pump and the high-pressure pump.
block.nuclearsq.pump_high_pressure_sqc.i: High-pressure pump, a part for the circulation pump and the sodium pump.
block.nuclearsq.pump_sodium_sqc.info: Strongest small pump, a part for the high-pressure large pump.
block.nuclearsq.quantum_computer_control: Controller of the quantum computer. It sits in the finished machine: right-click opens pattern cards and orders like the component assembler.
block.nuclearsq.radiation_concrete_sqc.i: Shields twice as well as normal concrete. A cheap wall around the reactor before you start it up.
Radioactive fallout after an explosion. It radiates and leaves contamination when it wears off. The decontamination sprayer washes it away, the waste repository accepts it.
block.nuclearsq.reactor_assembler_contro: Controller of the Reactor Assembler. It sits in the finished machine: right-clicking it opens the terminal, and data cables can be attached here. The machine itself comes as a kit from the small parts assembler.
block.nuclearsq.reactor_casing_sqc.info: Casing block made from reactor plates and steel. Part for the Heavy Assembler kit.
block.nuclearsq.reactor_detonator_sqc.in: Blows up the nearest fuel rod drive within 50 blocks: right-click, click again within 5 seconds, then a 3 second countdown runs. Hold Ctrl to see whether a drive is in range.
block.nuclearsq.recombiner_sqc.info: Passive catalytic recombiner: turns detonating gas (hydrogen and oxygen from the radiolysis of the coolant water) back into water. No power needed. Every recombiner within 24 blocks of the reactor core removes gas; without one it builds up during operation until it explodes.
Controller of the reheater: a part for its machine kit. In the finished machine right-clicking it opens the terminal, and data cables can be attached here.
block.nuclearsq.relief_tank_controller_s: Controller of the relief tank: a part for its machine kit. In the finished machine right-clicking it opens the terminal, and data cables can be attached here.
block.nuclearsq.reprocessing_plant_contr: Controller of the reprocessing plant: a part for its machine kit. In the finished machine right-clicking it opens the terminal, and data cables can be attached here.
block.nuclearsq.robot_arm_sqc.info: Takes items from a source (chest, machine, Create belt) and puts them down at the target. Reach 3 blocks, 1 item per second, with upgrades 4, 16, 32 or 64. Needs power (a cable on any side). Set source and target with the link tool. Dock it for the clean room: select the arm with the link tool, then Shift + right-click the machine (no power needed for this).
block.nuclearsq.rod_gripper_sqc.info: Crane for fuel rods, controlled by redstone only. Its hook hangs in the free column below it, grips an assembled fuel rod and raises or lowers it: pull rods out of the control rod drive, the cooling rack or a shaft and put them back. Inputs seen from the window side: back grip, left lift, right lower, top pull. Needs power.
block.nuclearsq.rtg_sqc.info: Maintenance-free power for outposts, 2 blocks tall: insert an isotope capsule (right-click), sneak with an empty hand to take it out. 3600 FE/t fresh, the output halves every 3 Minecraft days, after 12 days the capsule is spent. Power all around, no storage. Radiates slightly. The capsule drops out when broken.
block.nuclearsq.rtg_sqc.tip: Up to %s FE/t with a fresh capsule, falls over time. No refuelling, no storage
block.nuclearsq.sectional_door_panel_sqc: Building block for a sectional door. A rectangle up to 15×15 becomes a bright door of wide sections with a window band that runs up on rails. Sneak + left-click builds the door, right-clicking the door or a redstone signal next to it drives it.
block.nuclearsq.server_rack_controller_s: Controller of the Server Rack. It sits in the finished rack: right-clicking it opens the drive bays and shows how much storage the rack has and how much of it is free. Data cables can be attached here. The rack itself comes as a kit from the reactor assembler.
block.nuclearsq.server_rack_large_contro: Controller of the Large Server Rack. It sits in the finished rack: right-clicking it opens the drive bays and shows how much storage the rack has and how much of it is free. Data cables can be attached here. The rack itself comes as a kit from the reactor assembler.
block.nuclearsq.server_rack_small_contro: Controller of the Small Server Rack. It sits in the finished rack: right-clicking it opens the drive bays and shows how much storage the rack has and how much of it is free. Data cables can be attached here. The rack itself comes as a kit from the Small Parts Assembler.
block.nuclearsq.shaft_coupling_sqc.info: Goes one block behind the turbine's exhaust ring, right on the rotor axis. Behind it sits the consumer: shaft generator or Create shaft output.
block.nuclearsq.shaft_generator_controll: Controller of the shaft generator: a part for its machine kit. In the finished machine right-clicking it opens the terminal, and data cables can be attached here.
block.nuclearsq.shield_door_panel_sqc.in: Building block for a radiation door. A rectangle up to 15×15 becomes a thick lead door with a radiation sign, warning band, heavy hinges and a signal lamp above the door. From 2 blocks wide it has two leaves, it needs room in front to swing open. Sneak + left-click builds the door, right-clicking the door or a redstone signal next to it drives it.
block.nuclearsq.slag_crusher_controller_: Controller of the waste crusher: a part for its machine kit. In the finished machine right-clicking it opens the terminal, and data cables can be attached here.
block.nuclearsq.slide_door_panel_sqc.inf: Building block for a sliding glass door. A rectangle up to 15×15 becomes an automatic door with a header whose glass leaves slide into the wall on both sides. It needs half a door width of wall beside it. Sneak + left-click builds the door, right-clicking the door or a redstone signal next to it drives it.
block.nuclearsq.small_parts_assembler_co: Controller of the Small Parts Assembler. It sits in the finished machine: right-clicking it opens the terminal, and data cables can be attached here. The machine itself comes as a kit from the reactor assembler.
block.nuclearsq.sodium_heat_exchanger_sq: Heat exchanger for the sodium tiers. Plain component without an effect of its own.
block.nuclearsq.solar_collector_sqc.info: Solar panel on a stand, follows the sun, up to 312 FE/t by day. One power port sits at the bottom on the side you stand on when placing it (or to your left): many collectors in a grid pass the power on to the cable, battery or machine at the edge.
block.nuclearsq.solar_collector_sqc.tip: Up to %s FE/t in sunlight. 1 power port at the bottom on your side, small buffer (124,800 FE): place them in a grid, one cable at the edge is enough
block.nuclearsq.solar_field_controller_s: Controller of the solar field: a part for its machine kit. In the finished machine right-clicking it opens the terminal, and data cables can be attached here.
block.nuclearsq.solar_panel_sqc.info: Small solar power: most at noon, nothing at night, less in rain. Needs open sky, and gives a little more at higher altitude.
block.nuclearsq.solar_panel_sqc.tip: Up to %s FE/t in sunlight. 5 connectors (4 sides and bottom), small buffer (27,600 FE) for clouds and evening
block.nuclearsq.solder_machine_controlle: Control block of the Soldering Machine. It sits in the finished machine: right-click opens the terminal, and data cables can be attached here.
block.nuclearsq.speed_door_panel_sqc.inf: Building block for a high-speed door. A rectangle up to 15×15 becomes a door of red curtain with a vision strip and wind bars that rolls up as fast as allowed. Sneak + left-click builds the door, right-clicking the door or a redstone signal next to it drives it.
block.nuclearsq.spent_fuel_rack_controll: Controller of the spent fuel rack: a part for its machine kit. In the finished machine right-clicking it opens the terminal, and data cables can be attached here.
block.nuclearsq.steam_dryer_controller_s: Controller of the steam dryer: a part for its machine kit. In the finished machine right-clicking it opens the terminal, and data cables can be attached here.
block.nuclearsq.steam_generator_controll: Controller of the steam generator: a part for its machine kit. In the finished machine right-clicking it opens the terminal, and data cables can be attached here.
block.nuclearsq.steam_purifier_controlle: Controller of the large steam purifier: a part for its machine kit. In the finished machine right-clicking it opens the terminal, and data cables can be attached here.
block.nuclearsq.steam_purifier_sqc.info: Part for the large steam purifier (kit from the Heavy Assembler). The large machine turns contaminated steam into clean steam.
block.nuclearsq.steam_separator_controll: Controller of the steam separator: a part for its machine kit. In the finished machine right-clicking it opens the terminal, and data cables can be attached here.
block.nuclearsq.storage_crate_sqc.info: Crate, 2 blocks wide, with 27 slots, 54 with capacity upgrade I, 108 with capacity upgrade II. Every side can be set in the window: off, input, output or both. With "Eject" the crate itself pushes up to 64 items per second through its output sides into the inventory next to it. Contents and upgrade stay in the crate when you break it. Data cables connect on every side. Needs no power.
block.nuclearsq.storage_monitor_sqc.info: Wall screen on the data cable: lists every server rack on the network with its storage (used and total) and shows the whole storage at the top. Several monitors side by side (up to 4×4) form one large screen. If not all racks fit, it turns the page (5, 10 or 30 seconds). Right-click opens a window with every rack and the screen settings. A comparator reads the fill level.
block.nuclearsq.storage_terminal_sqc.inf: Shows every server rack on the data cable as one storage. Left-click takes a stack, right-click half, shift-click puts it into your inventory. With an item in hand, clicking the grid stores it. Needs no power itself.
block.nuclearsq.substation_controller_sq: Controller of the substation: a part for its machine kit. In the finished plant right-clicking it opens the terminal; with conductor wire in hand a right-click hooks the substation onto the overhead line.
block.nuclearsq.tin_ore_sqc.info: Drops raw tin (Fortune works). Very common, up to Y 96. Also comes out of the particle assembler.
block.nuclearsq.translator_basic_sqc.inf: Turbine translator tier 1. Right-click the turbine controller to install it: yield ×1.0 and throughput ×1, same as without a translator. Shift + right-click with an empty hand takes it out.
block.nuclearsq.translator_brass_sqc.inf: Turbine translator tier 2: +10 % power per mB of steam and the turbine swallows 1.5 times the steam (600 mB/t instead of 400). Install by right-clicking the turbine controller.
block.nuclearsq.translator_composite_sqc: Turbine translator tier 3: +25 % power per mB of steam and 2 times the steam intake (800 mB/t). Install by right-clicking the turbine controller.
block.nuclearsq.translator_glowstone_sqc: Turbine translator tier 4: +50 % power per mB of steam and 3 times the steam intake (1,200 mB/t). Install by right-clicking the turbine controller.
block.nuclearsq.turbine_basic_sqc.info: First-tier turbine part. Goes into the turbine kit and the brass rotor.
Rotor of the steam turbine. Goes into the turbine kit and the steel blades.
block.nuclearsq.turbine_controller_sqc.i: Controller of the turbine: a part for its machine kit. In the finished machine right-clicking it opens the terminal, and data cables can be attached here.
block.nuclearsq.turbine_glowstone_genera: Top turbine part made from the steel blades. Plain component without an effect of its own.
Power output of the steam turbine at the control panel: hands its power to cables and consumers next to it.
block.nuclearsq.turbine_port_steam_sqc.i: Steam input of the steam turbine, on top of the casing. Only takes clean steam from the steam purifier or superheated steam, never both mixed.
block.nuclearsq.turbine_port_water_sqc.i: Condensate port of the steam turbine: hands the exhaust steam to the condenser or feedwater heater.
block.nuclearsq.turbine_steel_blades_sqc: Third-tier turbine part made from the brass rotor. Part for the glowstone generator.
block.nuclearsq.uf6_converter_controller: Controller of the UF6 conversion plant: a part for its machine kit. In the finished plant right-clicking it opens the terminal, and data cables can be attached here.
block.nuclearsq.uranium_ore_sqc.info: Drops raw uranium (Fortune works). Found deep, from Y 48 down, needs an iron pickaxe. Also comes out of the particle assembler.
block.nuclearsq.vault_door_panel_sqc.inf: Building block for a vault door. A rectangle (for example 2×3) becomes a blast-proof door with frame, hinge straps, handwheel and bolts: the handwheel turns, the bolts retract, then the leaf swings open. From 4 cells wide it becomes two leaves. Sneak + left-click builds the door, right-clicking the door or a redstone signal next to it opens and closes it.
block.nuclearsq.vent_grille_sqc.info: First-tier cooling part. A part for the heat exchanger.
block.nuclearsq.vitrification_plant_cont: Controller of the vitrification plant: a part for its machine kit. In the finished plant right-clicking it opens the terminal, and data cables can be attached here.
block.nuclearsq.waste_repository_control: Controller of the waste repository: a part for its machine kit. In the finished machine right-clicking it opens the terminal, and data cables can be attached here.
block.nuclearsq.water_inlet_sqc.info: Water inlet for the loop and a part of the water treatment.
block.nuclearsq.water_treatment_controll: Controller of the large water treatment: a part for its machine kit. In the finished machine right-clicking it opens the terminal, and data cables can be attached here.
block.nuclearsq.water_treatment_sqc.info: Part for the large water treatment, the relief tank and the sodium heat exchanger.
block.nuclearsq.weapons_processing_contr: Controller of the weapons material plant: a part for its machine kit. In the finished plant right-clicking it opens the terminal, and data cables can be attached here.
block.nuclearsq.wifi_adapter_sqc.info: Makes the storage network on its data cable reachable wirelessly for linked wireless terminals. Range 48 blocks. Antenna modules (right-click, in this order) extend it: 2 antenna modules 128 and 320, sector antenna 1,024, directional dish 4,096, quantum antenna unlimited, even into other dimensions. Every stage shows on the adapter. Needs 12 FE/t, without power the Wi-Fi is off. Also charges wireless terminals in the inventory of players up to 4 blocks away. Several adapters form a radio mesh: adapters within mutual range (the smaller one counts) pass the connection on. Right-click with a wireless terminal links it.
block.nuclearsq.wind_turbine_large_contr: Controller of the Wind Power Plant: a part for its machine kit. In the finished machine a right click opens the terminal, and data cables can be attached here.
block.nuclearsq.wind_turbine_medium_cont: Controller of the Wind Turbine: a part for its machine kit. In the finished machine a right click opens the terminal, and data cables can be attached here.
block.nuclearsq.wind_turbine_small_contr: Controller of the Small Wind Turbine: a part for its machine kit. In the finished machine a right click opens the terminal, and data cables can be attached here.
block.nuclearsq.xenon_filter_sqc.info: Heated activated carbon delay line: holds back the noble gas xenon-135 until it has decayed. Needs 600 FE/t and carbon filters (up to 4, by right-click or hopper, used one after another for 20 minutes of operation each). Works within 24 blocks of the reactor core, two filters work twice as fast. Right-click with an empty hand shows its state.
block.nuclearsq.zircon_ore_sqc.info: Drops zircon (Fortune works) and experience. Deep down, from Y 32 down, needs an iron pickaxe. Always generates, no other mod supplies zircon. Also comes out of the particle assembler.

compendium.bank_apps.text:
The **Bank** app in SQ-OS has three tabs.
## Account
Shows player and balance, plus proceeds and goods waiting for pickup
**Deposit**, **Withdraw**, **Send** (to a player name), **Request**, **Log out**
## Requests
Whoever asks for money gets nothing until the other one **accepts**
Accept, decline or withdraw your own request. Open requests expire after **3 days**
## Loans
An offer with amount, **interest 0 to 100 %** and **1 to 60 days**. The money is held until the answer
Repayment = amount plus interest (rounded up), shown in the offer beforehand
Overdue loans show in **red**. Nothing is collected automatically
Unanswered offers expire after **3 days**, the money comes back
## sqc_bank
status, balance, deposit, withdraw, transfer, requestMoney, requests, answerRequest, offerLoan, loans, answerLoan, repayLoan, listItem, search, buy, claim and more
Errors arrive as Lua errors (pcall), no method takes a player ID
compendium.bank_apps.title: The Bank App
compendium.bank_auction.text:
The **Auctions** app has four tabs.
## Sell
Put goods in the container, tab **Sell**, enter a price, confirm at the terminal
The goods are **held** until sold or taken back
At most **50** open entries per player
## Market
All offers for everyone, with a **search field** (item name, item ID, seller) and pages
**Buy** books the price from your account at once. You cannot buy your own offer
## Mine
View and take back your own offers, the goods then wait for pickup
## Pickup
Shows proceeds and waiting goods. **Claim** books the proceeds to the account and puts the goods in the container, what does not fit keeps waiting
## Fee
**5 %** of the price (rounded up, at least 1) is paid by the seller. It goes to nobody and disappears from the economy
compendium.bank_auction.title: Auction House
compendium.bank_auction_monitor.text:
The **Auction Monitor** is an **app monitor** for real auctions with bids, without ComputerCraft.
## Requirements
Log in at the **Login Monitor**, the login counts here too
Connection to the **Bank Server** like the Bank Terminal (Bank Modem next to it or right at the server)
Payment is **digital** only, with the coins in the bank account
## Put up
Hold the item, tab **Put up**, **starting price**, optional **buyout**, **duration** 1 to 48 hours
The whole stack in your hand is put up, at most **10** auctions per player
Without bids you can withdraw the auction
## Bid
Tab **Market**, click an auction, enter the amount, **Bid**. Each new bid is at least **5 %** above the last one
The coins are **reserved** until the end. If you are outbid they go straight back to your account
**Buy now** ends the auction at once
## End and collect
The seller gets the final price minus a **2 %** fee into the account
Items are collected **where you put them in**: the winner collects at the monitor where they bid, the seller collects an unsold item at the monitor where it was put up
The first sold auction gives the rank **Auctioneer**
compendium.bank_auction_monitor.tip: Hang the Auction Monitor next to the Login Monitor, then everyone can log in and bid right there.
compendium.bank_auction_monitor.title: Auction Monitor
compendium.bank_coins.text:
Coins are **cash** for deposits and payouts. The account on the server is the truth.
## Values
**Coin** = 1
**Coin Roll** = 100
**Coin Bar** = 10,000
## Rules
There is **no recipe**: coins only come from **withdrawing** at the terminal and vanish when you **deposit**
Withdrawing only books the amount when the container has room, at most 11,520,000 at once
Depositing takes **all** coins from the container
Coins cannot be sold in the auction house
compendium.bank_coins.title: Coins
compendium.bank_confirm.text:
Everything that moves money or goods is confirmed **by you at the terminal**. So no foreign program can book in your name.
## Affected
Withdrawing and transferring
Accepting a request
Offering, accepting or repaying a loan
Buying or listing something for sale
## How it works
The app sends the wish, the server notes it
The **action bar** shows what would really happen: amount, name, goods, price
**Right-click the terminal** to confirm
The app repeats the call, now it runs **exactly once**
## Limits
Valid only for exactly this action with exactly these values
Expires after **20 seconds**, on logout and on any other request
Only the logged-in player can confirm
compendium.bank_confirm.tip: Read the text in the action bar before you click. It comes from the server, not from the program.
compendium.bank_confirm.title: Confirm by Right-Click
compendium.bank_exchange.text:
The **Exchange** is a market for **goods and raw materials**. Prices come only from the **supply and demand of the players**, no trader sets them.
Traded are raw materials like coal, iron, copper, gold, redstone, lapis, quartz, diamond and emerald as well as mod parts like steel sheet, lead shielding, zirconium, uranium oxide and metal dust
## How it works
Put goods into the container at the Bank Terminal and **store** them in the **Exchange** app, tab **Storage**
In the tab **Prices** pick a good and **Trade**
**Buy** or **Sell** with a **limit price per piece** and an amount
You confirm every order with a **right-click on the terminal**
## Matching
A new order trades at once against the best matching counter orders: **best price first, the older one at equal price** (price-time priority)
The trade happens at the **price of the waiting order**. Whoever bid higher gets the difference back at once
What does not match at once stays in the **order book** until you withdraw it
## Safety
**No short selling**: you can only sell what is in your storage
**No leverage**: a buy order reserves the money at once
Money and goods stay **held** until the order fills or is cancelled, cancelling returns everything
**No self-trading**: an order that would hit your own counter order is refused
At most 20 open orders per player, amount up to 10,000, limit up to 1 billion per piece
The seller pays **2 %** fee (rounded up, at least 1), it disappears from the economy
## Prices
In the tab **Trade** a **chart** shows the course of the last trades, plus day high, day low, volume and the bids in the book (without player names)
The tab **Prices** shows the change since the start of the day
## Price board
On an **image monitor** the command **kurstafel** shows a board with all goods: price, change (green rises, red falls), day high, day low and a mini chart. It pages by itself, is read-only and shows no player names
Put a computer next to the image monitor and next to the Bank Terminal (or a modem at the terminal) and type **kurstafel**. No login is needed, the board only reads public prices
SQ-OS has the same prices as the **Price Board** app
## sqc_bank
exchangeGoods, exchangeBook, exchangeOrders, exchangeStock, exchangePlace, exchangeCancel, exchangeDeposit, exchangeWithdraw, exchangeTicker
compendium.bank_exchange.tip: Without a counterparty an order just stays. Withdraw it when you need your money or goods back.
compendium.bank_exchange.title: Exchange
compendium.bank_login.text:
The **Login Monitor** is the first **app monitor**: one screen of its own per app, without ComputerCraft.
## Create an account
On the first **right-click** you create your account: enter the password and repeat it (at least **4**, at most **32** characters)
The account belongs to your player, nobody else can log in with it
The password is only stored salted and hashed in the world
## Log in
Right-click, password, **Log in**. The screen then shows an open lock and your name
The login is valid at **all app monitors** of the world
**Log out** in the window or **sneak + right-click** on the monitor
You are logged out automatically after **10 minutes** without use, when you leave the server and on a restart
## Security
After **5** wrong passwords the account is locked for **1 minute**
Forgot the password: an OP resets it with **/nuclearsq account reset <player>**, then you create a new one
## Connection
Like the Bank Terminal the monitor needs the **Bank Server**: a **Bank Modem** next to it or right at the server
Without a connection the screen shows **OFFLINE**, logging out still works
compendium.bank_login.tip: Hang the Login Monitor on the wall next to the other app monitors, then everyone sees at once whether they are logged in.
compendium.bank_login.title: Login Monitor
compendium.bank_modem.text:
The **Bank Modem** connects terminal and server without cables and without range.
Put one modem **right next to** the Bank Terminal and one **right next to** the Bank Server
They find each other in the same world network, even across dimensions, as long as the modems are loaded
A modem at the terminal alone is not enough, the server needs one too (or stands right at the terminal)
A computer at a modem operates the terminal beside it
The modem only says **whether** the bank is reachable, never **who** you are
Can be replaced by a real modem later
compendium.bank_modem.title: Bank Modem
compendium.bank_overview.text:
With the **bank** and the **auction house** players trade with each other without anyone being able to cheat. All money lives as an **account** on the server. A computer can only show it and send requests.
## Parts
**Bank Server**: brings the bank online
**Bank Terminal**: you log in here, the container takes coins and goods
**Bank Modem**: connects terminal and server without cables or range
**Coins**: cash for deposits and payouts
**SQ-OS**: the **Bank** and **Auctions** apps on a computer next to the terminal
## The way
Build server and terminal, a modem next to each
Put a computer next to the terminal and start **sqos**
Right-click the terminal to log in
Deposit, transfer, request money, lend, sell and buy goods
compendium.bank_overview.tip: The bank needs no power, but it needs CC:Tweaked: without a computer there is nothing to operate it.
compendium.bank_overview.title: Bank and Auction House
compendium.bank_security.text:
The bank is built so that nobody can cheat.
**Identity** comes only from the terminal (right-click), never from a program
Everything runs **on the server**, a computer only sees copies
Amounts are whole numbers from **1 to 1 trillion**, no overflow, no transfer to yourself
Every booking is **checked first, then done in one step**, on errors nothing changes
Every request, loan and offer has a **number** and a state, running it twice does nothing
Goods leave the container only after the offer exists, and drop when the block is broken
**Confirmation** by right-click for everything that moves money
At most 40 calls per second and player
An **audit log** keeps the last 500 bookings, the sum of all accounts is checked against deposits and payouts
Duplicate account names are refused instead of misdelivered
compendium.bank_security.tip: A small risk remains: a server crash exactly while saving can duplicate or lose goods or money once.
compendium.bank_security.title: Security
compendium.bank_server.text:
The **Bank Server** brings the bank online. Accounts, transfers, requests, loans and offers live **on the server** (in the world data), not in the block and not in the computer.
Right-click shows the number of accounts and open offers
One server is enough for the whole world
A terminal finds it when it stands **right next to it** or through **Bank Modems** (see there)
Breaking the block **loses no accounts**, the bank is just offline until a server stands again
compendium.bank_server.title: Bank Server
compendium.bank_terminal.text:
The **Bank Terminal** is where the customer stands. Whoever stands in front of it is that player to the bank, no program can claim to be someone else.
## Logging in
**Right-click** logs you in and opens the **container** (18 slots)
**Sneak + right-click** logs out
The login lasts **5 minutes**, only while you are online and within **8 blocks**
## The container
Coins in, then **Deposit** in the app
Goods in, then **Sell** in the auctions
Payouts and bought goods come out here
It belongs to whoever filled it: as long as something is inside, nobody else can log in. Breaking the block drops everything
## Computers
A computer **right at the terminal** (or at a modem next to it) operates the bank through the **sqc_bank** peripheral
compendium.bank_terminal.title: Bank Terminal
compendium.big_containment.text:
## Containment (31×32×31)
**Round concrete building** around the whole primary loop: steam generator, pump and pressurizer stand inside on the floor, the fuel rod drive sits in the middle on a **pedestal** right under the ceiling
Easiest is to set up the containment first and then put the drive kit on the pedestal: it snaps into the middle by itself. The other way round, the containment kit snaps onto a finished drive when you aim at its top (then you need 21 blocks of room below it for the pedestal)
At the very top of the flat roof sits the **hatch** with a **3×3 hole** right above the drive's nine shafts. Insert and remove the fuel rods there. The drive sits right below, the rods move in just like on a drive without containment
**Penetrations**: feedwater and wet steam do not pass through open walls but through one port outside and one inside each. What flows in outside comes out inside (and the other way round)
**Cables** pass through the wall at the lowest ring: power (up to 4,000 FE/t) and data cables each have a port outside and one inside. That way you reach the drive, steam generators, pressurizer and pump inside with power and data cables, without leaving a hole in the containment
**Primary lines** also pass through at the lowest ring: the **relief** line from the pressurizer to the relief tank (hot primary water, 160 mB/t, in inside, out outside) and **high-pressure injection** (320 mB/t) and **emergency cooling** (320 mB/t) into the primary loop (cold primary water, in outside, out inside)
**Bunker door** (2×3) at the front, right next to the controller, a vault door with handwheel, bolts and hinge straps: **right-click the door** or **sneak + right-click the controller** opens and closes it, a **redstone signal** at the controller (for example a lever on its front) or **redstone wire** right at the door opens it too. Open, you walk through; closed, it is as solid as the wall. It will not close while someone stands in the doorway
Airlock with 27 slots, power 150 FE/t for lights, ventilation and beacon, right-click the controller to open the terminal
## Ports (seen from the front)
**Airlock**: front, cell 17 from the left, level 1
**Feedwater in** (outside) and **feedwater out** (inside): left, cell 16 from the front, level 10
**Wet steam in** (inside) and **wet steam out** (outside): right, cell 16 from the front, level 17, just above the steam generator
**Energy in** (outside) and **energy out** (inside): left, cell 16 from the front, level 1
**Data port** outside and inside: back, cell 16 from the left, level 1; a data cable on either port reaches through the wall to the other
**Relief** (in inside, out outside): front, cell 19 from the left, level 1
**High-pressure injection** (in outside, out inside): front, cell 13 from the left, level 1
**Emergency cooling** (in outside, out inside): left, cell 13 from the front, level 1
**Hydraulic water** (in outside, out inside): front, cell 13 from the left, level 2, above the high-pressure injection
**Feedwater from treatment** (in outside, out inside): front, cell 13 from the left, level 3
compendium.big_containment.title: Containment
compendium.big_dryer.text:
## Steam Dryer (5×3×3)
**Steam dryer**: 40 → 39 steam + 1 water, sits after the **steam separator**
Comes as a **machine kit** from the heavy assembler, right-click the monitor to open the terminal
## Ports (seen from the front)
**Wet steam in**: right, cell 2 from the front, level 2
**Steam out**: left, cell 2 from the front, level 2
**Water out**: bottom, cell 3 from the left, cell 2 from the front
compendium.big_dryer.title: Steam Dryer
compendium.big_emergency.keywords: ECCS, emergency core cooling, primary water
compendium.big_emergency.text:
## Emergency Cooling (5×3×4)
**Emergency cooling**: water → **primary water**, 320 mB/t, 360 FE/t. The only source of primary water: use it to fill the primary loop for the first time and to top it up
**Always runs with power** and stops when the fuel rod drive is 75 % full
It is **triggered** by a **redstone signal** at the controller, **manual mode** (terminal: MANUAL) or when the pressurizer at the nearest fuel rod drive reports **below 20 %**. Below 20 % pressure the **high-pressure injection** starts too
**Boron emergency injection**: right-click with **boric acid** to put it in the stock (up to 8). When triggered, the emergency cooling injects one every 2 seconds (+100 ppm boron at the nearest fuel rod drive) and pushes the power down
Pipe the primary water into the **cold primary water in** port of the fuel rod drive
Comes as a **machine kit** from the heavy assembler, right-click the monitor to open the terminal
## Ports (seen from the front)
**Energy in**: front, cell 4 from the left, level 1
**Water in**: right, cell 3 from the front, level 1
**Primary water out**: left, cell 2 from the front, level 2
compendium.big_emergency.title: Emergency Cooling
compendium.big_hp_injection.keywords: HPI, HPSI, ECCS, high pressure injection, emergency cooling
compendium.big_hp_injection.text:
The **high-pressure injection** is part of the emergency cooling. It takes cold primary water from the **relief tank** and pushes it back into the primary loop.
## High-pressure injection (3×2×4)
Pumps up to **320 mB/t** of primary water
Uses **1,800 FE/t**, power buffer 300,000 FE
## When it runs
**By itself** as soon as the pressurizer at the nearest fuel rod drive reports **below 20 %**
With **redstone** at the controller or in **manual mode** (terminal)
Otherwise it waits **STANDBY** and uses no power
Primary water in on the right, out on the left, power at the back (seen from the front)
compendium.big_hp_injection.title: High-Pressure Injection
compendium.big_pressurizer.text:
The **pressurizer** holds the pressure in the primary loop. Its **surge line** hangs on the primary water, and it reports the pressure to the **nearest fuel rod drive**.
## Pressurizer (3×8×3)
Pressure **0 to 100 %**, in bar in the terminal: **50 % = 155 bar** is the set point
Below the set point it **heats** with power (**1,200 FE/t**, power buffer 180,000 FE)
If the core gets hotter than **60 %**, the pressure rises by itself
Above **90 %** the **relief valve** opens: up to **160 mB/t** of hot primary water go to the **relief tank** until the pressure is back at 85 %
If the pressurizer is nearly empty (below 5 %), the pressure drops fast
## Display
Below **20 %** the terminal shows **LOW PRESSURE**, while venting **VENTING**
The **pressure signal** at the back outputs the pressure as redstone 0 to 15
Primary water in on the right, relief on top, power on the left (seen from the front)
compendium.big_pressurizer.title: Pressurizer
compendium.big_relief_tank.keywords: PRT, relief tank, pressurizer relief tank, pressure relief
compendium.big_relief_tank.text:
## Relief Tank (9×3×9)
Takes the **relief** of the pressurizer (hot primary water, up to 160 mB/t)
Cools it with **coolant** into cold primary water: 1 mB of coolant per mB of relief, which comes out hot again (to the cooling tower)
**Sodium** cools 2 mB of relief per mB, **cryo coolant** 4 mB. It is used up and comes out as hot coolant
Keeps the cold primary water as a **reserve** (128,000 mB) for the high-pressure injection
Needs no power. Without coolant the relief stays in the inlet
Comes as a **machine kit** from the heavy assembler, right-click the monitor to open the terminal
## Ports (seen from the front)
**Relief in**: top, cell 5 from the left, cell 2 from the front
**Primary water out**: left, cell 5 from the front, level 1
**Coolant in**: right, cell 4 from the front, level 1
**Hot coolant out**: right, cell 6 from the front, level 1
compendium.big_relief_tank.title: Relief Tank
compendium.big_separator.text:
## Steam Separator (3×6×3)
**Steam separator**: 40 wet steam → 36 steam + 4 water, the **steam dryer** comes next
Comes as a **machine kit** from the heavy assembler, right-click the monitor to open the terminal
## Ports (seen from the front)
**Wet steam in**: front, cell 3 from the left, level 1
**Steam out**: top, cell 2 from the left, cell 2 from the front
**Water out**: left, cell 2 from the front, level 2
compendium.big_separator.title: Steam Separator
compendium.big_steam_generator.keywords: SG, steam generator, heat exchanger, secondary loop
compendium.big_steam_generator.text:
## Steam Generator (7×16×7)
Separates the loops of the **pressurized water reactor**: hot **primary water** from the fuel rod drive flows through its heating tubes, gives its heat to the **feedwater** and goes back to the drive cold. The feedwater turns into **wet steam**, which is not radioactive
1 mB of primary water makes 0.5 mB of wet steam: 640 mB/t (nine full tier 1 rods) make **320 mB/t**
Each steam generator handles up to **2,560 mB/t** of primary water and gives up to **1,280 mB/t** of wet steam (feedwater 1,280 mB/t)
**Preheated feedwater** makes **15 % more** steam from the same heat
If feedwater runs out or the steam tank is full, the primary water stays hot. Then the flow at the drive stops and the core heats up
**One loop is enough**: a steam generator takes up to **2,560 mB/t** of primary water and makes up to **1,280 mB/t** of wet steam, as much as one main coolant pump delivers. One steam generator per pump is enough
Needs no power. Comes as a **machine kit** from the heavy assembler, right-click the monitor to open the terminal
## Tube leak
If a heating tube breaks, **contaminated steam** comes out. Separator and dryer pass it on, only a **steam purifier** in front of the turbine cleans it again
It breaks for sure on **overpressure** (100 % at the pressurizer) or an **overheated core**, otherwise rarely through **wear**: the longer the steam generator runs, the more often
The terminal shows **TUBE LEAK** and the wear in percent
**Maintenance**: switch the steam generator off and press MAINTENANCE in the terminal. That seals the leak and resets the wear to 0
## Ports (seen from the front)
**Hot primary water in**: right, cell 4 from the front, level 2
**Cold primary water out**: left, cell 4 from the front, level 2
**Feedwater in**: right, cell 4 from the front, level 10
**Wet steam out**: top, cell 4 from the left, cell 4 from the front
**Data port**: back, cell 4 from the left, level 2
compendium.big_steam_generator.title: Steam Generator
compendium.big_tower.text:
**Cooling tower**: hot coolant → coolant, 960 mB/t, a little evaporates (no monitor, state in chat)
**Cooling tower XL** (63×120×63, water basin at the bottom): 3,840 mB/t, four times the cooling tower
The hot coolant comes out of the top of the **condenser**. One cooling tower serves six small or one and a half large condensers, the XL 24 small or six large
Comes as a **machine kit** from the heavy assembler
## Cooling Tower (21×40×21)
**Hot coolant in**: front, cell 12 from the left, level 1
**Coolant out**: front, cell 10 from the left, level 1
## Cooling Tower XL (63×120×63)
**Hot coolant in**: front, cell 33 from the left, level 1
**Coolant out**: front, cell 31 from the left, level 1
