1. A **substation** at the plant, cables on the two **power in** ports at the front
2. **High-voltage pylons** up to 64 blocks apart, **large pylons** up to 256 blocks from each other
3. A second **substation** at the destination
4. With the **conductor wire**, click substation → pylon → pylon → … → substation in turn
5. Lay cables from the **power outputs** of the destination substation
## Values
Up to **262,144 FE/t** over the line, no loss
Every line is made of two wires
1 conductor wire per started 16 blocks of span
Between a large and a small pylon or a substation the short reach applies (64 blocks)
All substations on the same grid share the power fed in
## Notes
Pylons themselves take no power
Shift + conductor wire on a pylon takes its wires down
A pylon in an unloaded chunk breaks the line there
compendium.transport_grid.tip: Cross-arms face across your view direction when placed: look along the line.
compendium.transport_grid.title: Overhead Line
compendium.transport_item_pipes.text:
Item pipes carry **items** from machine to machine, e.g. yellowcake from the ore mill into the enrichment centrifuge and the enriched uranium on into reprocessing. You can tell them by the sight glass with yellow ribs, yellow like the item ports.
## Tiers
**Basic**: 16 items/s
**Reinforced**: 64 items/s
**Hardened**: 256 items/s
## Connecting
Item pipes connect **automatically** to item pipes and to anything that accepts or provides items (item ports, chests, hoppers, inventories of other mods)
An **item output** (copper orange) pushes its results into the pipe by itself, an **item input** (yellow) takes them
Items go **to machines first**, then on through the pipe, never back where they came from
Each piece holds at most one stack of one kind. If the pipe is broken, its contents drop
## Wrench
Right-click a side: **connected → pulling → disconnected**
**Pulling** (shut-off valve with red handwheel): the pipe draws from a chest by itself
**Shift + right-click** dismantles the pipe
compendium.transport_item_pipes.tip: Item pipes never connect to fluid pipes or cables. Tiers do connect to each other; throughput follows the weakest piece.
compendium.transport_item_pipes.title: Item pipes
compendium.transport_pipes.text:
Pipes carry **any fluid**: water, coolant, steam, sodium, crude oil, diesel, tar and naphtha, also gases such as ethylene. One pipe carries one fluid at a time.
## Tiers
**Basic**: 1,000 mB/t
**Reinforced**: 4,000 mB/t
**Hardened**: 16,000 mB/t
## Connecting
Pipes connect **automatically** to neighboring pipes and to anything that accepts or provides fluid (ports, tanks, machines)
Machines with outputs (reactor, turbine, reprocessing …) **push** into the pipe themselves
## Wrench
Right-click a side: **connected → pulling → disconnected**
**Pulling** (shut-off valve with red handwheel): the pipe actively draws from the block, e.g. from water treatment
**Shift + right-click** dismantles the pipe
compendium.transport_pipes.tip: Different tiers connect to each other. Throughput follows the weakest piece.
compendium.transport_pipes.title: Pipes
compendium.transport_substation.text:
The **substation** (5×5×5) is the start and end of the overhead line and hands the power out directly at the destination.
## Setup
Place it with the **substation kit** from the Heavy Assembler
Hook it to pylons or another substation with the **conductor wire**; every line is made of **two wires** on the bushings on top
## Connections
**Power in** at the front right and front left, up to **131,072 FE/t** each
Four **power outputs**: right, left, back right, back left, up to 131,072 FE/t each
The outputs convert by themselves depending on what is attached: **cables and machines** get FE (also mods that say RF), a **Power Grid terminal** (Create: Power Grid only) gets the power for its circuit
SU does not travel over the line: put the **Create shaft output** right behind the turbine's shaft coupling for that
## Grid
Power fed in is shared every tick across **all finished substations on the grid**, including this one
Feed and supply buffers hold **262,144 FE** each, no loss
compendium.transport_substation.tip: Right-click the controller to see how many substations are on the grid and how much power is flowing.
compendium.transport_substation.title: Substation
compendium.weapons_arming.text:
All three bombs are detonated the same way.
1. Arm it with **shift + right-click** (empty hand) or **redstone**
2. The fuse runs (default **20 seconds**) with ticking and a countdown
3. Then the bomb falls as soon as there is room below and detonates on impact
## Transport
Disarmed, a bomb is safe to transport, also on Create contraptions
Note: Move far away and back up the world first.
compendium.weapons_arming.tip: Fuse time and the needed falling speed are in the server config (countdownSeconds, impactSpeed).
compendium.weapons_arming.title: Arming and Detonating
compendium.weapons_bomb.keywords: atomic bomb, A-bomb, nuclear weapon, nuke
compendium.weapons_bomb.text:
The smallest bomb, just **1 block** in size. It tears a crater of about **75** blocks down to bedrock, followed by a mushroom cloud, ash and radiation.
## Building
In the **reactor assembler**: 4 comparators, 2 steel sheets, 4 **uranium cores**, 2 lead shielding and 4 TNT
Four nuclear bombs are the base of the **large nuclear bomb**
Note: How to arm and detonate it is on the page "Arming and Detonating".
compendium.weapons_bomb.title: Nuclear Bomb
compendium.weapons_bomb_large.text:
A bomb of **2×2×4** blocks with a crater of about **112** blocks. It is placed as one item and builds itself up, so there has to be enough room above.
## Building
In the **reactor assembler**: **4 nuclear bombs**, a **weapons plutonium core** and 4 steel sheets
Four large nuclear bombs are the base of the **Tsar Bomb**
Breaking any part gives back the whole bomb
compendium.weapons_bomb_large.title: Large Nuclear Bomb
compendium.weapons_overview.text: Three nuclear bombs, each made from the one before. Drag to move, scroll to zoom, click to open the page.
compendium.weapons_overview.title: Weapons
compendium.weapons_processing.text:
## Weapons material plant (7×4×5)
Item plant with **1 input, 4 results**: a lead hall with cascade and manipulators behind viewing windows
Power bottom right (seen from the front), items **in on top**, results **out** bottom left
Radiates while running, needs **4,800 to 7,200 FE/t**
## Recipes
4 plutonium oxide → **1 plutonium metal** (800 ticks, 50 % ash on top)
2 plutonium metal → **1 weapons plutonium core** (600 ticks)
## Use
**Large Nuclear Bomb**: 1 weapons plutonium core
**Tsar Bomba**: 4 weapons plutonium cores
The small nuclear bomb still needs a uranium core
compendium.weapons_processing.tip: Plutonium oxide comes from the fast breeder and from reprocessing the bred elements.
compendium.weapons_processing.title: Weapons material plant
compendium.weapons_tsar.text:
The largest bomb: **3×3×6** blocks, crater about **314** blocks. The blast wave breaks glass and leaves far beyond the crater.
## Building
In the **reactor assembler**: **4 large nuclear bombs**, **4 weapons plutonium cores** and an atomic hull plate
Breaking any part gives back the whole bomb
Note: Move very far away and back up the world first.

gui.nuclearsq.big_crafter.tip.aux: Second input: fluorite for UF6 conversion, enriched uranium for the pellet press, tin or coal for the foundry. Used up with the main ingredient on every run.
gui.nuclearsq.big_crafter.tip.bonus: A %s %% chance of a second batch (output upgrade).
gui.nuclearsq.big_crafter.tip.card: Without a card only the light class is made. Each card unlocks one more class and needs more power.
gui.nuclearsq.big_crafter.tip.class.exot: Ancient debris, ender pearl, netherite scrap, echo shard.
gui.nuclearsq.big_crafter.tip.class.heav: Raw iron, raw gold, lapis, osmium, lead, obsidian.
gui.nuclearsq.big_crafter.tip.class.medi: Coal, raw copper, redstone, quartz, tin.
Each card one more stack of fuel in storage, up to 8.
Each card makes the fuel burn 6.25 % longer, with 8 cards +50 %.
Each card about +43 % power, with 8 cards +344.5 %.
gui.nuclearsq.big_crafter.tip.coal_stock: Fuel in the extra stacks of the buffer cards. It refills the fuel field by itself.
gui.nuclearsq.big_crafter.tip.column: Lowest water column above the 9 shafts, in blocks. Needed: %s.
gui.nuclearsq.big_crafter.tip.feed: Uses %s mB/t while rods are cooling. Buffer: %s / %s mB.
gui.nuclearsq.big_crafter.tip.fluid: In the tank: %s of %s mB. Feed it by pipe or bucket.
gui.nuclearsq.big_crafter.tip.gen: Makes %s FE/t while fuel is burning. Power leaves at the power port on the left (seen from the front).
gui.nuclearsq.big_crafter.tip.ghost: Pattern: this part goes into this slot. The machine only makes the chosen recipe.
gui.nuclearsq.big_crafter.tip.ghost.clea: Clear pattern: the ghost items disappear, the recipe lock is lifted and the machine accepts every recipe again.
gui.nuclearsq.big_crafter.tip.ghost.fill: Click to move the ingredients for one run of the pattern from your inventory into the slots.
Shift+click fills as many runs as fit into the slots and your inventory can supply.
gui.nuclearsq.big_crafter.tip.place.cool: Fully cooled: moves up, every mined block gives cooled spent fuel.
Cooling %s %%, about %s °C. Only with feed and a full water column.
gui.nuclearsq.big_crafter.tip.place.empt: Put an assembled fuel rod (docker + 4 rods) on top of the shaft: it moves in by itself.
gui.nuclearsq.big_crafter.tip.place.free: The rod is up and can be mined.
gui.nuclearsq.big_crafter.tip.place.fres: The rod still has fuel and does not cool here. Put it back into the reactor.
gui.nuclearsq.big_crafter.tip.place.in: The rod is moving into the shaft.
gui.nuclearsq.big_crafter.tip.place.lowe: Click: move the rod back in
gui.nuclearsq.big_crafter.tip.power2: Connect a cable to the power port.
gui.nuclearsq.big_crafter.tip.progress.a: The recipe in the 5×5 grid is being built; the result appears on the right.
gui.nuclearsq.big_crafter.tip.progress.g: Remaining burn time of the current fuel.
gui.nuclearsq.big_crafter.tip.progress.p: The arms bring the balls together; with the flash an item from the unlocked classes appears.
Average cooling of all spent rods in the shafts.
gui.nuclearsq.big_crafter.tip.progress.r: The input is being reprocessed; the results go into the 4 output slots.
gui.nuclearsq.big_crafter.tip.progress.s: One part from the 3x3 grid, the result goes to the output slot.
gui.nuclearsq.big_crafter.tip.state.data: Switched off over the data network. Turn it back on with enable at a console or computer.
Insert fuel: anything that burns in a furnace (coal, charcoal, wood, coal block ...).
No storage: the generator only burns while a cable or consumer takes the power at the power port. That way no coal is wasted.
gui.nuclearsq.big_crafter.tip.state.inco: Structure incomplete: a part is missing. Breaking it returns the kit, then place it again.
gui.nuclearsq.big_crafter.tip.state.need: Ingredients for the recipe are still missing.
gui.nuclearsq.big_crafter.tip.state.noac: The acid tank holds less than one run needs. Right-click a sulfuric acid bucket or feed it by pipe.
gui.nuclearsq.big_crafter.tip.state.noar: This recipe needs a docked robot arm: take the link tool, right-click the robot arm, then Shift + right-click the machine. More in the compendium under Robot Arm Docking.
gui.nuclearsq.big_crafter.tip.state.noau: The extra slot is missing something: fluorite (UF6 conversion), enriched uranium (pellet factory), tin or coal (foundry). It goes next to the main ingredient in the input.
gui.nuclearsq.big_crafter.tip.state.nofe: Water must keep flowing into the water port at the bottom (pipe or pump). Without a feed the rods don't cool and they radiate.
gui.nuclearsq.big_crafter.tip.state.noin: No matching recipe in the input.
gui.nuclearsq.big_crafter.tip.state.nopo: Not enough stored power. Connect a cable to the power port.
gui.nuclearsq.big_crafter.tip.state.nowa: Too little water in the tank of the water port: the cooling pond needs at least 1,000 mB, the leaching plant as much as one run needs.
gui.nuclearsq.big_crafter.tip.state.off: Switch it back on with the ON button.
gui.nuclearsq.big_crafter.tip.state.shal: At least 5 blocks of water must stand above each of the 9 shafts. Otherwise the rods don't cool and they radiate.
gui.nuclearsq.big_crafter.tip.upgrade.ef: Heavier classes come up more often.
gui.nuclearsq.big_crafter.tip.use.partic: Base demand 3,840 FE/t. Class cards, speed, efficiency and output raise it, energy lowers it.
Put blank cards here. “Write” stores the template's recipe on one card, which appears below.
gui.nuclearsq.component_assembler.cancel: Cancels the running order. Parts already made stay in storage.
Cancels all waiting orders. Parts already made stay in storage.
Put written cards here. Their results can be ordered at the Storage Terminal.
Removes all ghost items from the template.
gui.nuclearsq.component_assembler.comput: Cores: that many runs go at once (1 always, each free CPU core on the data network adds one). Orders: used and allowed size, each free GB of RAM allows larger orders. Cluster: that many Component Assemblers on the network share orders and free computing power.
gui.nuclearsq.component_assembler.kind.t: Recipe found for the template: crafting table (shape matters), Small Parts Assembler or Reactor Assembler (counts matter, position doesn't).
gui.nuclearsq.component_assembler.stalle: Nothing has moved for minutes, usually ingredients are missing from storage. Put them back or cancel the order.
gui.nuclearsq.component_assembler.status: The result would fit neither in the racks nor in the buffer (east). Nothing is used up until there is room again: add drives, empty the racks or take the buffer.

A rack, a cable or part of the plant is in an unloaded chunk. The assembler pauses and uses nothing up until everything is loaded again. The server config assembler.keepLoaded keeps it loaded permanently.
No order. Order at a Storage Terminal on the same data network.
The assembler needs power at the power port (west) while working, per working core as much as shown in the header.
No powered server rack on the data cable. Attach the cable to the controller or a port.
The machine is not fully built or switched off.
Ingredients for the next run are missing from storage (someone took them out). Put them back or cancel the order.
A run is in progress. Ingredients come from the racks and the result goes back there.
gui.nuclearsq.component_assembler.templa: Lay out the recipe as at the crafting table or in the assembler. Ghost items only, nothing is used up. Left-click with an item sets the stack, right-click adds one; with an empty hand left-click clears the slot, right-click removes one.
Tempo Modules go here, up to %s. Each makes a run faster, but the power per core grows faster than the speed (as with AE2, by the square).
gui.nuclearsq.component_assembler.tile.c: Used and allowed CPU cores: that many passes run at the same time (one always, every free core on the data network adds one).
gui.nuclearsq.component_assembler.tile.p: How many component assemblers share this network and split its cores and RAM.
gui.nuclearsq.component_assembler.tile.s: Used and allowed job size. Every free GB of RAM on the data network allows bigger jobs, ∞ means no limit.
Writes the recognised recipe on a blank card. The output slot below must be empty.
gui.nuclearsq.data.console.title: COMMAND CONSOLE
gui.nuclearsq.data.terminal.search.tip: Finds plants by name (also German names, umlauts optional, several words) and items on the drives of the server racks. Right-click clears the search.
Computing power on the network: assigned / available (CPU and RAM modules in the server racks)
gui.nuclearsq.data.terminal.tip.drive: Used %s, %s types. Click shows the items.
gui.nuclearsq.data.terminal.tip.locate: Shows a light column above the plant and its coordinates
gui.nuclearsq.data.terminal.title: DATA TERMINAL
gui.nuclearsq.data_multi.hint: Arrows or mouse wheel: pick plant and values
gui.nuclearsq.device.battery.hint: Output at the front · redstone holds
gui.nuclearsq.device.battery.reg.charge_: The battery stops charging once this level is reached. Power it does not take keeps flowing on to other batteries and consumers.
The battery starts charging again once its level has dropped to this value or below.
gui.nuclearsq.device.battery.reg.release: After a lock the outputs only give power again once the level has reached this value.
The outputs stop giving power once the level reaches or drops below this value (reserve).
gui.nuclearsq.device.battery.reg.use: Left half: less · right half: more · mouse wheel · Shift = 1 % steps
gui.nuclearsq.device.battery.tip.mode.0: Outputs always give power, redstone is ignored
gui.nuclearsq.device.battery.tip.mode.1: Outputs only give power while a redstone signal reaches the controller
gui.nuclearsq.device.battery.tip.mode.2: A redstone signal at the controller holds the outputs
gui.nuclearsq.device.battery.tip.port_in: Input: takes up to %s FE/t · click: on/off · right-click: make it an output
gui.nuclearsq.device.battery.tip.port_ou: Output: gives up to %s FE/t · click: on/off · right-click: make it an input
gui.nuclearsq.device.big.fx.tip.bar: Ignition charge: %sFE of %sFE. The reactor is drawing %sFE/t from the buffer. From 60 %% it preheats the plasma, from 85 %% it confines it magnetically, at 100 %% it ignites.
gui.nuclearsq.device.big.fx.tip.graph: Cyan: ignition charge, amber: plasma temperature. One point per half second while the terminal is open.
gui.nuclearsq.device.big.fx.title: Ignition sequence
gui.nuclearsq.device.big.hint_emergency: Always runs with power · boron injection on redstone, pressure below 20 % or MANUAL.
gui.nuclearsq.device.big.tip.auto: Runs while a redstone signal is present or the pressurizer at the nearest drive reports below 20 %.
gui.nuclearsq.device.big.tip.burn: Burn rate setting %s %%. A signal at the signal input (1 to 15) overrides it.
gui.nuclearsq.device.big.tip.feed: %s FE/t are coming in at the power inputs right now and go onto the line.
gui.nuclearsq.device.big.tip.line_out: %s FE/t are leaving the power outputs right now. What nobody takes stays in the buffer.
gui.nuclearsq.device.big.tip.manual: Always runs, regardless of the signal.
gui.nuclearsq.device.big.tip.net: Net power %s FE/t. Ignition progress %s %%, buffer up to %s FE.
gui.nuclearsq.device.big.tip.off: Stop the machine: it processes nothing, tanks stay filled.
gui.nuclearsq.device.big.tip.out: %s FE/t is being taken at the power port right now. No storage: the rest is lost.
gui.nuclearsq.device.big.tip.out_buffer: %s FE/t is being taken at the power port right now. The rest goes into the buffer.
gui.nuclearsq.device.big.tip.plasma: Plasma temperature %s million K. Burn rate in the plasma %s %%.
gui.nuclearsq.device.big.tip.power2: Connect a cable to the power port. Without power the machine stops.
gui.nuclearsq.device.big.tip.pressure: %s bar (%s %%). Set point 155 bar (50 %%), relief above 90 %%.
gui.nuclearsq.device.big.tip.repair: Seals a tube leak and resets the wear to 0.
gui.nuclearsq.device.big.tip.repair_off: Maintenance only works while the steam generator is switched off.
gui.nuclearsq.device.big.tip.shaft_power: %s FE/t of shaft power currently comes from the turbine.
gui.nuclearsq.device.big.tip.state.ash_f: The tritium tank is full: take tritium away at the port, then ignite again.
gui.nuclearsq.device.big.tip.state.disru: The plasma has collapsed: 10 second pause, the wall took damage.
gui.nuclearsq.device.big.tip.state.heati: The buffer heats the plasma; once the ignition energy is reached it burns.
gui.nuclearsq.device.big.tip.state.idle: Ready, but input is missing or the output is full.
gui.nuclearsq.device.big.tip.state.low_p: The pressure is below 20 %: fill the pressurizer with primary water and give it power.
gui.nuclearsq.device.big.tip.state.no_co: Coolant is missing or too little: the wall heat rises, after 20 seconds a disruption follows.
gui.nuclearsq.device.big.tip.state.no_dr: No driver core in slots 1 to 4: put a uranium core or plutonium core into the item input.
gui.nuclearsq.device.big.tip.state.no_fu: Deuterium or tritium is missing (without tritium deuterium alone starts it at 12 %).
gui.nuclearsq.device.big.tip.state.no_po: Not enough stored power. Connect a cable to the power port.
gui.nuclearsq.device.big.tip.state.no_pr: No hot primary water at the inlet: connect the fuel rod drive (hot primary water out) by pipe.
gui.nuclearsq.device.big.tip.state.no_sh: No shaft power: the turbine is not running, or the coupling is missing or does not face the controller.
gui.nuclearsq.device.big.tip.state.no_so: Too little sodium in the loop (at least 8,000 mB): right-click a sodium bucket or feed it by pipe.
gui.nuclearsq.device.big.tip.state.no_su: No sunlight: it is night, or the sky above the middle of the field is blocked.
gui.nuclearsq.device.big.tip.state.no_wi: The rotor stands still: a lull, a roof over the hub, or the dimension has no wind (Nether, End).
gui.nuclearsq.device.big.tip.state.off: Switch it back on with the ON button below.
gui.nuclearsq.device.big.tip.state.plasm: The plasma is burning and delivers power.
gui.nuclearsq.device.big.tip.state.resid: Lead container full (16 filter residue). Put a hopper or chest at the residue port and it carries on.
gui.nuclearsq.device.big.tip.state.sodiu: The sodium loop is leaking: it loses sodium and radiates. Switch the plant off and maintain it, then refill sodium.
gui.nuclearsq.device.big.tip.state.stand: Waits for the trigger signal (redstone) or for pressure below 20 % at the pressurizer.
gui.nuclearsq.device.big.tip.state.tube_: A heating tube has broken: the steam comes out contaminated. Put a steam purifier in front of the turbine, switch the steam generator off and maintain it.
gui.nuclearsq.device.big.tip.state.unfor: Structure incomplete: a part is missing. Breaking it returns the kit, then place it again.
gui.nuclearsq.device.big.tip.state.venti: The pressure was above 90 %: the relief valve is open until it is back at 85 %.
gui.nuclearsq.device.big.tip.state.wall_: The wall tile is worn out: put a new tile into the item input and leave room in the output.
gui.nuclearsq.device.big.tip.sub_feed: %s FE/t are arriving at the power inputs, %s FE/t over the line.
gui.nuclearsq.device.big.tip.sun_power: %s FE/t is what the field makes from sunlight right now.
gui.nuclearsq.device.big.tip.throughput: %s mB/t are being processed right now.
gui.nuclearsq.device.big.tip.wind_power: The plant currently makes %s FE/t from the wind. Output = peak × hub height × open surroundings × wind strength; the data network shows the three factors.
gui.nuclearsq.device.rod.hint: Same channel = all drives move together
gui.nuclearsq.device.rod.hint2: Only locked rods (Lock Rod) are inserted.
gui.nuclearsq.device.rod.tip.card2: Only clamped rods (Lock Rod) are inserted.
gui.nuclearsq.device.rod.tip.channel2: Drives on the same channel move together. "-" = single. Change with < and >.
gui.nuclearsq.device.rod.tip.core: Inserted rods heat the core. It is cooled passively and by the primary water the main coolant pump drives through the vessel.
gui.nuclearsq.device.rod.tip.core2: At 100 %% the core overheats (no power until below 60 %%). If it stays at 100 %% for 12.5 s, it explodes.
gui.nuclearsq.device.rod.tip.empty: No fuel rod in this shaft: place one on top of the frame
gui.nuclearsq.device.rod.tip.head: Moving in/out: rods travel to the target · On target: standing still · No power / Not built: nothing moves.
gui.nuclearsq.device.rod.tip.hydraulic2: %s / %s mB. Needs hydraulic water at the port "%s".
gui.nuclearsq.device.rod.tip.k.cooling2: Passive + primary water flow in the vessel + pumps (coolant) nearby.
gui.nuclearsq.device.rod.tip.k.gas2: Builds up during operation. At 100 %% it ignites: first the hull is damaged, the second time the reactor room is blown up. Recombiners within 24 blocks remove it.
gui.nuclearsq.device.rod.tip.k.heat2: From 80 %%: alarm, steam and radiation leak out.
gui.nuclearsq.device.rod.tip.k.power2: Shown on the flux signal and in the control room. 0 while overheated.
gui.nuclearsq.device.rod.tip.k.xenon2: From 30 %% output drops, at 100 %% the reactor stops until below 60 %%. Powered xenon filters with carbon filters within 24 blocks remove it.
gui.nuclearsq.device.rod.tip.lock: Clamp the rod and allow it to be inserted
gui.nuclearsq.device.rod.tip.mode.redsto: Redstone: the signal strength (0-15) at the control port sets the position.
gui.nuclearsq.device.rod.tip.mode.termin: Terminal: the position comes from the slider and buttons here.
gui.nuclearsq.device.rod.tip.position: Rod position (0 = out, 15 = fully pulled in)
gui.nuclearsq.device.rod.tip.power2: Needed to move the rods. Without power they stay put; the core keeps heating.
gui.nuclearsq.device.rod.tip.release: Rod moves fully up, the frame opens, then it can be taken out
gui.nuclearsq.device.rod.tip.scram2: Switches the whole group to terminal mode with target 0: all rods are pulled out.
gui.nuclearsq.device.rod.tip.seg.out: All out: target 0, all rods fully out.
gui.nuclearsq.device.rod.tip.seg2: Acts on the whole group (same channel).
gui.nuclearsq.device.rod.tip.slider2: Drag: 0 = all rods out, 15 = fully inserted.
gui.nuclearsq.device.rod.tip.v.dry2: The rods heat but no primary water flows: the core heats up fast. SCRAM at once, feed cold primary water on the left (east) and take hot water away on the right (west).
gui.nuclearsq.device.rod.tip.v.rate2: Depends on insertion depth and remaining charge of the rods (all nine rods together up to 640 mB/t).
gui.nuclearsq.device.rod.tip.v.steam2: Port "%s": right (west) in the wall. Take it away by pipe. When the tank is full, the flow stops and the core heats up.
gui.nuclearsq.device.rod.tip.v.temp2: Display only. About 290 °C cold, up to 325 °C at full power, much more without flow. The core heat is shown at the top.
gui.nuclearsq.device.rod.tip.v.water2: Port "%s": left (east) in the wall. Takes primary water only.
gui.nuclearsq.device.rod.tip.vessel: The inserted rods heat the vessel: cold primary water turns into hot primary water.
gui.nuclearsq.device.rod.tip.vessel2: Cold in on the left (east), hot out on the right (west), on to the steam generator. Fuel is only used while primary water flows.
gui.nuclearsq.device.rod.title: Fuel Rod Drive Terminal
gui.nuclearsq.device.tip.gauge: The red part of the scale is a warning.
gui.nuclearsq.door.hint: Redstone or a data cable open the door too
gui.nuclearsq.door.kind.airlock: Kind: airlock door, leaf slides aside
gui.nuclearsq.door.kind.cold: Kind: cold room door, swings open
gui.nuclearsq.door.kind.industrial: Kind: industrial roller door, rolls up
gui.nuclearsq.door.kind.lift: Kind: lift gate, rises in one piece
gui.nuclearsq.door.kind.perforated: Kind: perforated roller door, rolls up
gui.nuclearsq.door.kind.slide: Kind: sliding glass door, slides into the wall
gui.nuclearsq.door.kind.vault: Kind: vault door, leaf swings open
gui.nuclearsq.door.none: No door found: place a panel directly against the controller
gui.nuclearsq.door.ragged: No door: the panels do not form a full rectangle
gui.nuclearsq.exo_station.buffer.tip: Power from the cables on its way into the core (up to 20,000 FE per tick).
gui.nuclearsq.exo_station.buffer.title: Station buffer
gui.nuclearsq.exo_station.core.tip: Its tier sets battery and module slots. It can only be taken out once no modules are left.
gui.nuclearsq.exo_station.core.title: Exo Core
gui.nuclearsq.exo_station.core_charge.ti: Power in the battery of the inserted Exo Core.
gui.nuclearsq.exo_station.modules.tip: As many slots are open as the core tier allows. Without piece and core all stay locked.
gui.nuclearsq.exo_station.modules.title: Module slots
gui.nuclearsq.exo_station.piece.tip: Helmet, chestplate, leggings or boots of the exoskeleton. The modules stay stored in the piece.
gui.nuclearsq.exo_station.piece.title: Exo piece
gui.nuclearsq.exo_station.state.no_core: No Exo Core inserted: without it there are no module slots.
gui.nuclearsq.future_chest.upgrade.capac: Doubles the slots per upgrade, up to 2 (32, 64, 128). Can only be removed while the extra slots are empty.
gui.nuclearsq.future_chest.upgrade.magne: The placed chest pulls in loose items within 6 blocks while there is room.
gui.nuclearsq.future_chest.upgrade.sorte: When you close the window, equal stacks are merged and everything is ordered by item ID.
gui.nuclearsq.gate.charge_hi.tip: Once this level is reached the input takes nothing more and the network in front backs up.
gui.nuclearsq.gate.charge_lo.tip: The input only takes power again once the buffer has dropped to this value or below.
gui.nuclearsq.gate.hint: In at the back, out at the front · wrench turns it
gui.nuclearsq.gate.rate.tip: The percentage of the highest cable tier the isolator lets through per tick at most.
gui.nuclearsq.gate.release_hi.tip: After a lock the output only gives power again once the buffer has reached this value.
gui.nuclearsq.gate.release_lo.tip: The output stops giving power once the buffer reaches this value (reserve).
gui.nuclearsq.gate.use: Left half: less · right half: more · mouse wheel · Shift = 1 % steps
gui.nuclearsq.item_port.enable.tip: Turns the port on or off. While off it moves nothing and accepts nothing.
gui.nuclearsq.item_port.mode.tip: Import: from the inventory into the racks. Export: from the racks into the inventory. Click to switch.
gui.nuclearsq.item_port.slot.tip: Click with an item to set it as filter, click without an item to clear the slot. You keep the item.
gui.nuclearsq.logbook.empty: No entries yet. The logbook follows the plants on the data network.
gui.nuclearsq.logbook.hint: T = game day and clock, then real time
gui.nuclearsq.logbook.title: LOGBOOK
gui.nuclearsq.nanobots.tip.bots: Number of bots and speed (count and speed upgrades). Every bot works alone on its own block, a tree always belongs to exactly one bot.
gui.nuclearsq.nanobots.tip.cancel: Discard the points set so far.
gui.nuclearsq.nanobots.tip.cargo: Stacks on board. They are delivered when a target is finished or the cargo is full.
gui.nuclearsq.nanobots.tip.confirm: Start the order (or a second right-click on a block).
gui.nuclearsq.nanobots.tip.fn.0: Break an area, always from TOP to BOTTOM. If the top is not reachable, the bots dig a vertical tunnel first.
gui.nuclearsq.nanobots.tip.fn.1: Build or fill with the off-hand block, always from BOTTOM to TOP.
gui.nuclearsq.nanobots.tip.fn.2: Replace: the block at the first point is replaced by the off-hand block within the area.
gui.nuclearsq.nanobots.tip.fn.3: Copy: remembers the area as a template (instant, no bots).
gui.nuclearsq.nanobots.tip.fn.4: Paste: builds the template at the anchor (rotate, mirror, offset).
gui.nuclearsq.nanobots.tip.form: Shape of the area. Click: next, right-click: previous (key B).
gui.nuclearsq.nanobots.tip.gheight: Height of the cylinder (Alt + Shift + mouse wheel).
gui.nuclearsq.nanobots.tip.gradius: Radius of the round shapes (Shift: steps of 5, or Shift + mouse wheel).
gui.nuclearsq.nanobots.tip.hollow: Outer layer only or completely filled.
gui.nuclearsq.nanobots.tip.offset: Offset of the anchor in blocks: click +1, Shift +4, right-click -1, middle-click 0.
gui.nuclearsq.nanobots.tip.phase: What the swarm is doing: searching, travelling, working, delivering, returning.
gui.nuclearsq.nanobots.tip.pmode: AIR ONLY fills free cells only, REPLACE breaks what is there.
gui.nuclearsq.nanobots.tip.port: Coupled Drone Item Port (click to release it).
gui.nuclearsq.nanobots.tip.progress: Work progress on the current block.
gui.nuclearsq.nanobots.tip.radius: Working radius of the swarm around you (Shift: bigger steps).
gui.nuclearsq.nanobots.tip.recall: Call the swarm back; the cargo is delivered.
gui.nuclearsq.nanobots.tip.redo: Run the order you took back again (key Y).
gui.nuclearsq.nanobots.tip.rot: Rotate the template by 90° (key R, right-click: back).
gui.nuclearsq.nanobots.tip.source: Material from the inventory or from the coupled Drone Item Port.
gui.nuclearsq.nanobots.tip.tab.gadget: Area by corner points: break, build, replace, copy, paste.
gui.nuclearsq.nanobots.tip.tab.tasks: Search the surroundings: trees, items, ore, planting, harvesting, tilling, stone.
gui.nuclearsq.nanobots.tip.task: Click selects the task. The swarm searches for it in the surroundings.
gui.nuclearsq.nanobots.tip.undo: Take back the last order (key Z).
gui.nuclearsq.nanobots.tip.upgrades: Four upgrade slots: speed, count, reach.
gui.nuclearsq.nanobots.title: NANO SWARM
gui.nuclearsq.net_pipe_adapter.enable.ti: Turns the adapter on or off.
gui.nuclearsq.net_pipe_adapter.info.expo: Sends the filter items from the network into the pipe
gui.nuclearsq.net_pipe_adapter.info.no_f: Put an item from your inventory into a slot
gui.nuclearsq.net_pipe_adapter.info.none: No machine with a pattern on the pipe
gui.nuclearsq.net_pipe_adapter.info.stor: Takes everything from the pipe and stores it in the network
gui.nuclearsq.net_pipe_adapter.info.targ: %d machine(s) with a pattern on the pipe
gui.nuclearsq.net_pipe_adapter.mode.tip: Switches the mode: Demand supplies the ingredients for the pattern of the machine on the pipe, Store puts everything from the pipe into the network, Export sends the filter items into the pipe.
gui.nuclearsq.net_pipe_adapter.problem.n: no machine with a pattern at the end of the pipe
no storage on the network (check data cable, rack, power)
no item pipe and no machine at the flange
gui.nuclearsq.net_pipe_adapter.slot.filt: Click with an item to set the filter, shift-click clears the slot. The adapter sends these items into the pipe.
gui.nuclearsq.net_pipe_adapter.slot.mach: First machine at the end of the pipe that has a pattern set.
gui.nuclearsq.net_pipe_adapter.slot.patt: Result of the pattern. The adapter supplies its ingredients.
gui.nuclearsq.power.balance.tip2: Production minus consumption. Plus: power is left over (storage charges). Minus: storage is being drawn down.
gui.nuclearsq.power.cons.tip2: What the machines on the network actually draw, averaged over the last second.
gui.nuclearsq.power.prod.tip2: All producers together. Load is %s %% of the peak output (%s FE/t).
gui.nuclearsq.power.title: POWER MONITOR
gui.nuclearsq.robot_arm.clear_filter.tip: Clears all filter slots. Afterwards the arm moves everything.
gui.nuclearsq.robot_arm.clear_source.tip: Clears the source. Set it again with the link tool.
gui.nuclearsq.robot_arm.clear_target.tip: Clears the target. Set it again with the link tool.
gui.nuclearsq.robot_arm.filter.tip: Click a slot with an item on the cursor to set it as filter, click with an empty cursor to clear the slot. Empty = everything.
gui.nuclearsq.robot_arm.filter.title: Filter
gui.nuclearsq.robot_arm.hint: Link tool: click = source, Shift + click = target (up to 4, in turn)
gui.nuclearsq.robot_arm.power.tip: The arm needs power for every move (a cable on any side).
gui.nuclearsq.robot_arm.power.title: Power buffer
gui.nuclearsq.robot_arm.toggle.tip: Switches the arm on or off. A redstone signal also pauses it.
gui.nuclearsq.robot_arm.upgrades.tip: One step of the amount per move for each slot: 1, 4, 16, 32, 64 items.
gui.nuclearsq.robot_arm.upgrades.title: Upgrade slots
gui.nuclearsq.rod_gripper.fn_grip.tip: Holds the rod under the hook as long as the signal is on. Without a signal the hook lets go.
gui.nuclearsq.rod_gripper.fn_lift.tip: Hook (and gripped rod) rises one block per step.
gui.nuclearsq.rod_gripper.fn_lower.tip: Hook (and gripped rod) sinks one block per step if the cell below is free.
gui.nuclearsq.rod_gripper.fn_pull.tip: Hook runs to the rod, grips it and pulls it all the way up.
gui.nuclearsq.rod_gripper.hook.tip: Blocks below the crane. 0 = right below the block, all the way up.
gui.nuclearsq.rod_gripper.hook.title: Hook depth
gui.nuclearsq.rod_gripper.power.tip: Every step of the hook costs 300 FE. Cable on any side.
gui.nuclearsq.rod_gripper.power.title: Power
gui.nuclearsq.rod_gripper.problem.blocke: Hook blocked: next cell occupied or end stop
gui.nuclearsq.rod_gripper.problem.clampe: Rod is locked in the drive (clamp closed)
gui.nuclearsq.rod_gripper.toggle.tip: Turned off, the gripper ignores redstone.
gui.nuclearsq.storage.crafting.clear.tip: Puts everything in the grid back into the network, what does not fit into your inventory.
gui.nuclearsq.storage.crafting.energy.ti: %s of %s FE. Every crafted recipe costs 20 FE. Charge in the charging field of a Wi-Fi adapter or with a charger.
gui.nuclearsq.storage.crafting.result.ti: Click takes the result. Shift-click crafts as often as ingredients, space and battery allow. Empty grid slots are refilled from the racks.
gui.nuclearsq.storage.crafting.title: Crafting Terminal
gui.nuclearsq.storage.monitor.no_racks: No server rack on the network
gui.nuclearsq.storage.monitor.note: Applies to the screen on the wall and stays saved in the monitor. The comparator still reads every rack.
gui.nuclearsq.storage.monitor.title: STORAGE
gui.nuclearsq.storage.rack.cards.offline: Without power (or switched off), new orders for these cards are blocked. Running orders continue. Needs: %s FE/t.
The rack has power (%s FE/t). The recipes of its cards are available to all component assemblers on the data network.
gui.nuclearsq.storage.rack.compute.tip: %s CPU/RAM module(s) in the rack. While the rack has power, they supply consoles and terminals on the data network. Each module takes a bay that is then missing for a drive.
gui.nuclearsq.storage.rack.offline.tip: Without power (or switched off) the drives cannot be reached. The items stay on the drives. Needs: %s FE/t.
gui.nuclearsq.storage.rack.online.tip: The rack has power and can be reached on the storage network. Use with all drives: %s FE/t.
gui.nuclearsq.storage.rack.priority.tip: New items go to racks with higher priority first (0 to 9).
gui.nuclearsq.storage.rack.space.none.ti: Put hard drives into the bays. Every drive adds room for items and kinds.
gui.nuclearsq.storage.terminal.no_racks: No server rack on the network
Connect the terminal with data cable to the data port (back) or the controller of a server rack.
gui.nuclearsq.storage.terminal.offline.t: The racks need power at the power port at the back and must be switched on. The items stay on the drives.
gui.nuclearsq.storage.terminal.order.com: Build plan for %s branches too much, please order less
gui.nuclearsq.storage.terminal.order.res: The raw materials for %s have been reserved elsewhere in the meantime. Please order again.
gui.nuclearsq.storage.terminal.order.too: Order too big: %s needs %s units, add RAM modules to the network or order less
gui.nuclearsq.storage.terminal.racks.tip: %s of %s racks on the network have power
gui.nuclearsq.storage.terminal.sort.name: Name
gui.nuclearsq.storage.terminal.sort.tip: Click to switch between amount (most first) and name.
gui.nuclearsq.storage.terminal.title: Storage Terminal
gui.nuclearsq.storage_crate.eject.tip: Pushes up to %s items per second into the inventory next to every output side (orange or green).
gui.nuclearsq.storage_crate.mode.0: Off: pipes and hoppers cannot reach the crate here
gui.nuclearsq.storage_crate.side.tip: Left-click: next setting, right-click: previous. Grey off, blue input, orange output, green both. Left and right as seen standing in front of the crate.
gui.nuclearsq.storage_crate.upgrade.tip: Upgrade I: 54 slots, upgrade II: 108 slots. It only comes out if the contents fit into the smaller size.
gui.nuclearsq.survey_tablet.empty: No map yet. Send the drone off with shift + right-click into the air, open this again after the flight.
gui.nuclearsq.survey_tablet.title: Radiation Map
gui.nuclearsq.term.kindhint.coolant: Connect a pipe; the port block shows the color of its type.
gui.nuclearsq.term.kindhint.energy: Connect a cable (Forge Energy). Without power the machine stops.
gui.nuclearsq.term.kindhint.feedwater: Connect a pipe; feedwater comes from water treatment.
gui.nuclearsq.term.kindhint.gas: Connect by pipe; deuterium, tritium and helium have no bucket.
gui.nuclearsq.term.kindhint.item: Connect a hopper or item pipe.
gui.nuclearsq.term.kindhint.primary: Connect with a pipe; primary water stays in the closed primary loop.
gui.nuclearsq.term.kindhint.steam: Connect a pipe (e.g. to the turbine).
gui.nuclearsq.term.kindhint.water: Connect a pipe; buckets work too.
gui.nuclearsq.term.kindhint.wet_steam: Connect a pipe; wet steam comes from the reactor loop.
gui.nuclearsq.term.recipes.pick.clear: This recipe is the current pattern. Click to clear the pattern and lift the lock.
gui.nuclearsq.term.recipes.pick.template: Click to lay this recipe into the template as ghost items. Then insert a blank card and press Write.
gui.nuclearsq.term.recipes.pick.tip: Click to lay this recipe into the machine's grid as a see-through pattern and lock the machine to it.
gui.nuclearsq.term.recipes.tip: Shows a list of every recipe of this machine right here. Click again or press Esc to close it.
gui.nuclearsq.term.style.tip2: Tube monitor (CRT) or modern dark. Applies to all terminals and is saved (config/nuclearsq-client.toml).
gui.nuclearsq.tree.hint: Scroll with mouse wheel · green = in inventory
gui.nuclearsq.tree.title: NuclearSQ: Progression
gui.nuclearsq.turbine.tip.f.load: %s SU = %s FE/t (SU for comparison with Create).
gui.nuclearsq.turbine.tip.f.out2: With a shaft coupling and consumer, power goes over the shaft first.
gui.nuclearsq.turbine.tip.f.shaft: %s FE/t currently go over the shaft to the consumer.
gui.nuclearsq.turbine.tip.f.steam: Steam tank %s / %s mB. Steam enters through the steam port.
gui.nuclearsq.turbine.tip.f.storage: %s / %s FE. Take it from the power port.
gui.nuclearsq.turbine.tip.g.speed: %s of %s RPM. The red zone is overspeed.
gui.nuclearsq.turbine.tip.g.temp: %s °C. The red zone is too hot.
gui.nuclearsq.turbine.tip.head.idle: Running, but no steam arrives (or storage is full).
gui.nuclearsq.turbine.tip.head.incomplet: Structure incomplete: a part is missing. Breaking it returns the kit, then place it again.
gui.nuclearsq.turbine.tip.head.stopped: Start it with the ON button.
gui.nuclearsq.turbine.tip.throttle2: How much steam the turbine takes at most (0-100 %). Drag to set.
gui.nuclearsq.turbine.title: Steam Turbine
hud.nuclearsq.decon_robot.help: Arrow keys drive and turn, right-click arm up/down, Shift ends
hud.nuclearsq.decon_robot.no_agent: NO CLEANING AGENT: go to the dock
hud.nuclearsq.dosimeter.title: DOSIMETER · DAILY DOSE
hud.nuclearsq.layout.hint: Hold Alt: drag display · right-click resets
hud.nuclearsq.survey_drone.help: W A S D fly, space up, shift down, mouse turns, right-click ends
item.nuclearsq.acid_plant_kit_sqc.info: Acid plant (5×3×4): roasts ore to sulfur, makes sulfuric acid from sulfur and water and hydrofluoric acid from fluorite. Kit from the Heavy Assembler.
item.nuclearsq.advanced_reactor_casing_s: Casing made from reactor casings, osmium heat plates and lead shielding (4 pieces). For the kits of later machines. From the CNC mill.
item.nuclearsq.andesite_housing_sqc.info: Housing made from andesite alloy and iron sheets. Base part for the pump, the docker, the pressure chamber and the brass bearing.
item.nuclearsq.anti_rad_medicine_sqc.inf: Against radiation sickness: helps once you have taken too much, but does not protect against new radiation. The dosimeter shows how long it still works.
item.nuclearsq.assembler_tempo_sqc.info: Plug-in card for the Component Assembler: makes every run faster. Up to 8 in the module slot of the menu, each one a level. Power per core grows faster than speed. Made in the Small Parts Assembler.
item.nuclearsq.atomic_hull_plate_sqc.inf: The strongest plate, made from atomic alloy and lead shielding. Used for every experimental tier part, the plutonium core and the Tsar Bomba.
item.nuclearsq.basic_circuit_sqc.info: 3 osmium ingots + 6 redstone + 2 copper ingots. Goes into control board I. From the micro assembler.
item.nuclearsq.battery_large_kit_sqc.inf: Battery with 64 million FE and 131,072 FE/t per port, with a second input and output at the back; every port can be reversed in the terminal. Kit from the Heavy Assembler.
item.nuclearsq.battery_medium_kit_sqc.in: Battery with 16 million FE and 16,000 FE/t per port. Every port can be switched off or reversed in the terminal, the outputs controlled by redstone. Kit from the Heavy Assembler.
item.nuclearsq.battery_small_kit_sqc.inf: Battery with 4 million FE and 4,000 FE/t per port. Every port can be set to input or output in the terminal, the charge stays in the kit when broken. Kit from the Heavy Assembler.
item.nuclearsq.blast_furnace_kit_sqc.inf: Blast furnace (5×4×5): a tilting melting furnace. Pours steel in large batches, melts raw ore and dust and makes lead blocks and special alloys. Kit from the Heavy Assembler.
item.nuclearsq.borax_sqc.info: Borax crystals from borax ore or the Particle Assembler. In the boric acid plant 1 borax with sulfuric acid and water makes 4 boric acid.
Boric acid plant (3×3×3): dissolves borax ore in sulfuric acid and water and crystallizes boric acid. Kit from the Heavy Assembler.
item.nuclearsq.boric_acid_sqc.info: Boron for the primary loop: right-click the control rod drive controller, each piece adds 100 ppm (1,000 at most). Boron absorbs neutrons and slowly lowers the power down to half. It only leaves through the ion exchanger.
item.nuclearsq.brass_bearing_sqc.info: Brass bearing for everything that spins: rotors, pumps, the shaft coupling and the controllers of the mill, centrifuge and assemblers.
item.nuclearsq.bred_blanket_sqc.info: A blanket element with fresh plutonium. Radiates strongly. The reprocessing plant turns it into plutonium oxide, depleted uranium and ash.
item.nuclearsq.bred_neptunium_sqc.info: Neptunium blanket element with fresh plutonium-238, strongly radioactive. The reprocessing plant turns it into plutonium-238 oxide, ash and a little neptunium oxide.
item.nuclearsq.breeder_blanket_sqc.info: Rods of depleted uranium for the blanket of the fast breeder (slots 5 to 12 of the item input). In the neutron flux of the drivers it becomes a bred element.
item.nuclearsq.carbon_filter_sqc.info: Activated carbon cartridge for the xenon filter: holds back the noble gas xenon-135 until it has decayed. Right-click the xenon filter to insert it. Lasts 20 minutes of operation.
item.nuclearsq.castor_large_sqc.size: 2×3×2 blocks, 36 × 16 places · from the heavy assembler
item.nuclearsq.castor_large_sqc.tip: Placed next to an item port, it feeds rods in and picks cooled fuel up.
item.nuclearsq.chemical_lab_kit_sqc.info: Chemical lab (3×3×3): stirred kettle with a heating jacket. Makes lye from kelp, nitric acid from gunpowder and sulfuric acid, grease from lithium and diesel, and regenerates spent ion resin with the lye. Kit from the Heavy Assembler.
item.nuclearsq.chip_1_sqc.info: Simple chip from wafer, copper and redstone (small parts assembler). Ingredient for small machines and the first RAM and CPU tiers.
item.nuclearsq.chip_2_sqc.info: More precise chip from chip I, pure silicon, rubber, photoresist and gold. Ingredient for mid-size machines and mid RAM and CPU tiers.
item.nuclearsq.chip_3_sqc.info: High-precision chip from chip II, pure silicon, ender pearl, diamond, gold and HDPE sheet. Ingredient for large machines and the highest RAM and CPU tiers.
item.nuclearsq.clean_room_kit_sqc.info: Dust-free precision chamber (3×3×3): makes chip III and the highest RAM and CPU tiers. Needs an attached robot arm so nobody touches the parts. Kit from the Heavy Assembler.
item.nuclearsq.cnc_mill_kit_sqc.info: CNC mill (2×2×3): gantry mill with a spindle, mills seals, plates, lead shielding and casings in a 3×3 grid. Kit from the Small Parts Assembler.
item.nuclearsq.coal_generator_card_buffe: Goes into field B in the coal generator's window, up to 8: each card lets it store one more stack of fuel, with 8 cards 9 stacks. It runs longer without refilling.
item.nuclearsq.coal_generator_card_effic: Goes into field E in the coal generator's window, up to 8: each card makes one piece of fuel burn 6.25 % longer, with 8 cards +50 % (1.5 times as long, a third less fuel).
item.nuclearsq.coal_generator_card_outpu: Goes into field O in the coal generator's window, up to 8: each card gives about +43 % power, with 8 cards +344.5 % (720 to 3200 FE/t). The fuel burns faster to match.
item.nuclearsq.coal_generator_kit_sqc.in: Starting power before the reactor: burns coal, wood or lava and delivers 720 FE/t, enough for two assemblers. Kit from the crafting table.
item.nuclearsq.coin_bar_sqc.info: Cash worth 10000. Withdraw and deposit at a Bank Terminal; there is no recipe.
item.nuclearsq.coin_roll_sqc.info: Cash worth 100. Withdraw and deposit at a Bank Terminal; there is no recipe.
item.nuclearsq.coin_sqc.info: Cash worth 1. You only get it by withdrawing at a Bank Terminal and pay it back in there; there is no recipe.
item.nuclearsq.coke_sqc.info: Coke from the kiln (2 coal give 1 coke) or from the polymer plant (1 coal and 200 mB tar give 2 coke). Counts as coal everywhere (steel, enriched carbon) and burns twice as long in a furnace.
item.nuclearsq.component_assembler_kit_s: Fabrication cell (5×4×5) for autocrafting: builds what you order at the Storage Terminal, intermediate products first. Recipes come from pattern cards in its 8 slots, ingredients from the server racks on the data cable. Needs 1,440 FE/t per core while working, more with Tempo Modules. Kit from the Heavy Assembler.
item.nuclearsq.compute_assembler_kit_sqc: Compute assembler (3×3×3): same recipes as the reactor assembler, but its speed grows with the free computing power in the data network up to x128 (128 CPU / 2,048 GB). Power grows with it. Data cable to the data port or the controller.
item.nuclearsq.compute_cluster_kit_sqc.i: Computing cluster (3×4×2) in rack style: built-in compute modules, 32 CPU cores and 512 GB RAM for the data network. Power at the red port on the back (780 FE/t), cooling water at the blue one, data cable at the teal one. Without water it runs hot and throttles. Kit from the Reactor Assembler.
item.nuclearsq.condenser_kit_sqc.info: Large condenser: turns 640 mB/t of exhaust steam into water, the coolant leaves hot towards the cooling tower. Kit from the Heavy Assembler.
item.nuclearsq.containment_kit_sqc.info: Containment around the fuel rod drive: takes the steam from the vessel, gives it feedwater and has an airlock with 27 slots. Kit from the Heavy Assembler.
item.nuclearsq.contaminated_rubble_sqc.i: Rubble sucked up into the decon robot's tank. It radiates itself: do not collect it in your inventory, bring it to a waste barrel or the shredder.
item.nuclearsq.control_board_1_sqc.info: The simplest control board. Goes into almost every tier 1 controller, into terminals, the console, the Geiger counter and the translators.
item.nuclearsq.control_board_2_sqc.info: Better control board made from 4 elite circuits and a control board I. Used for the turbine, the fuel rod drive, larger controllers and tier 3 parts.
item.nuclearsq.control_board_3_sqc.info: The best control board, made from 4 ultimate circuits and a control board II. Used for the experimental tier and the high-pressure pump controller.
item.nuclearsq.control_desk_kit_sqc.info: Control desk with command line, plant list, alarms, gauges and an emergency stop for every fuel rod drive on the network. Needs 24 FE/t. Kit from the Heavy Assembler.
item.nuclearsq.control_rod_drive_kit_sqc: The heart of the reactor: lowers up to nine fuel rods into its reactor pressure vessel and heats the primary water. Needs power and hydraulic water. Kit from the Heavy Assembler.
item.nuclearsq.coolant_bucket_sqc.info: Coolant for the pumps (factor 1.0, water only 0.4) and the cooling side of the condenser.
item.nuclearsq.cooling_tower_large_kit_s: Cooling tower: cools 960 mB/t of hot coolant from the condensers back down, a little evaporates. Enough for six small condensers. Kit from the Heavy Assembler.
Huge cooling tower with a water basin: 3,840 mB/t, four times as much as the normal one. Kit from the Heavy Assembler.
item.nuclearsq.copper_coil_sqc.info: Copper coil made from copper and iron bars. Used for everything that makes or carries power: turbine, generators, batteries, cables and power ports.

item.nuclearsq.copper_plate_sqc.info: A rolled copper ingot from the Plate Mill (1 ingot makes 1 plate).

item.nuclearsq.cracker_kit_sqc.info: Cracker (3×3×3): reactor vessel with stirrer. Cracks 20 mB/t naphtha into ethylene, 1,800 FE/t. Kit from the Heavy Assembler.
item.nuclearsq.cryo_coolant_bucket_sqc.i: Strongest coolant (factor 2.4), only for the sodium pump and the high-pressure pump.
item.nuclearsq.decon_dock_kit_sqc.info: Decon dock (4×2×2): open parking bay for the decon robot. Back in: the dock charges the battery (500 FE/t) and refills the cleaning agent with lye (10 mB/t) and empties the rubble tank into the rubble output. With diesel as emergency power (200 FE per mB). Ports: power, lye, diesel, rubble out (these four also at the back), data. Kit from the heavy assembler.
item.nuclearsq.decon_remote_sqc.info: Right-click a decon robot to bind it. Right-click in the air starts control: camera view of the robot, arrow keys like walking, Right-click lowers and raises the arm (it only cleans with the arm down), Shift ends. Range 48 blocks. In strong radiation the picture gets noisy. Zone job: Shift + right-click two blocks to mark a zone (up to 32 x 32), Shift + right-click in the air sends the robot off. It drives through it lane by lane and then parks backwards where it started, for example in the dock. Shift + right-click again calls it back.
item.nuclearsq.decon_robot_sqc.info: Remote-controlled tracked robot: while driving it sucks up fixed contamination and fallout in front of its scoop and keeps it as rubble in its tank (200 points). Right-click the ground to place it. It only cleans with the arm down and needs cleaning agent (lye, 1000 mB, 5 mB per cleaning pulse). Charging, refilling and emptying the rubble: back it into the decon dock; charging also works next to a power source (battery port, generator). It takes damage in radiation: right-click a lead block for a lead plate (only a tenth), steel sheet repairs.
item.nuclearsq.decon_sprayer_sqc.info: Removes contamination stuck to floors, walls, players and items, and washes fallout away. It does nothing on fuel rods and running machines, where the material itself radiates.
item.nuclearsq.depleted_uranium_sqc.info: Waste of enrichment and of reprocessing bred elements, hardly fissile. Eight of them plus zircaloy make a breeder blanket element for the fast breeder.
item.nuclearsq.deuterium_separator_kit_s: Deuterium separator (3×3×3): turns water into deuterium for the fusion reactor, 2,400 FE/t. Kit from the heavy assembler.
item.nuclearsq.distillation_column_kit_s: Distillation column (3×6×3): refinery. 20 mB/t crude oil make naphtha, diesel, tar and sulfur, 1,200 FE/t. Kit from the Heavy Assembler.
item.nuclearsq.dosimeter_sqc.info: Beeps in your inventory at half and at the daily limit, the daily dose resets every game day. Hold Alt and drag to move the box.
item.nuclearsq.electrolyzer_kit_sqc.info: Electrolyzer (3×3×3): splits water into hydrogen and oxygen, 2 mB/t hydrogen at 2,400 FE/t. Kit from the Heavy Assembler.
item.nuclearsq.elite_circuit_sqc.info: 2 basic circuits, 6 gold ingots, 8 glowstone dust, 2 blaze powder, 1 ender pearl. Goes into control board II. From the Small Parts Assembler.
item.nuclearsq.emergency_cooling_kit_sqc: Emergency cooling: always runs with power, turns 320 mB/t of water into primary water for the reactor. Kit from the Heavy Assembler.
item.nuclearsq.enriched_carbon_sqc.info: 2 coal + 1 redstone make 2 in the small parts assembler, in the chemical lab 2 coal + 200 mB sulfuric acid make 4. Used for the carbon moderator and HDPE sheets.
item.nuclearsq.enriched_uranium_sqc.info: Fuel from the Enrichment Centrifuge or from reprocessing. In the reprocessing plant 1 of them makes 1 uranium core, in the pellet factory with uranium oxide dust 1.5 cores.
item.nuclearsq.enrichment_centrifuge_kit: Enrichment centrifuge: turns 2 yellowcake into 1 enriched uranium and 1 depleted uranium, and 1 UF6 cylinder even into 2 and 1. Sometimes uranium oxide on top. Kit from the Heavy Assembler.
item.nuclearsq.equipment_assembler_kit_s: Manufacturing cell (3×2×2) with a fitting dummy, assembly arm and press: makes the exoskeleton and its modules, protective suits, decon devices, pocket batteries and the respirator mask in a 3×3 grid. Kit from the Reactor Assembler.
item.nuclearsq.etched_obsidian_sqc.info: In the chemical lab 4 obsidian + 300 mB hydrofluoric acid make 2. The small parts assembler turns them into 2 refined obsidian ingots with 1 diamond and 1 osmium ingot.
