item.nuclearsq.exo_module_speed_4_sqc.in: Tier IV module for the exo leggings: +10 % movement speed per tier, tier 4 here. Only works on the worn piece with a charged Exo Core in your inventory and uses 40 FE per second.
item.nuclearsq.exo_module_speed_5_sqc.in: Tier V module for the exo leggings: +10 % movement speed per tier, tier 5 here. Only works on the worn piece with a charged Exo Core in your inventory and uses 50 FE per second.
item.nuclearsq.exo_module_step_1_sqc.inf: Tier I module for the exo leggings: +0.2 blocks step height per tier, tier 1 here. Only works on the worn piece with a charged Exo Core in your inventory and uses 10 FE per second.
item.nuclearsq.exo_module_step_2_sqc.inf: Tier II module for the exo leggings: +0.2 blocks step height per tier, tier 2 here. Only works on the worn piece with a charged Exo Core in your inventory and uses 20 FE per second.
item.nuclearsq.exo_module_step_3_sqc.inf: Tier III module for the exo leggings: +0.2 blocks step height per tier, tier 3 here. Only works on the worn piece with a charged Exo Core in your inventory and uses 30 FE per second.
item.nuclearsq.exo_module_step_4_sqc.inf: Tier IV module for the exo leggings: +0.2 blocks step height per tier, tier 4 here. Only works on the worn piece with a charged Exo Core in your inventory and uses 40 FE per second.
item.nuclearsq.exo_module_step_5_sqc.inf: Tier V module for the exo leggings: +0.2 blocks step height per tier, tier 5 here. Only works on the worn piece with a charged Exo Core in your inventory and uses 50 FE per second.
item.nuclearsq.exo_module_strength_1_sqc: Tier I module for the exo chestplate: +1 melee damage per tier. Only works on the worn piece with a charged Exo Core in your inventory and uses 10 FE per second.
item.nuclearsq.exo_module_strength_2_sqc: Tier II module for the exo chestplate: +1 melee damage per tier. Only works on the worn piece with a charged Exo Core in your inventory and uses 20 FE per second.
item.nuclearsq.exo_module_strength_3_sqc: Tier III module for the exo chestplate: +1 melee damage per tier. Only works on the worn piece with a charged Exo Core in your inventory and uses 30 FE per second.
item.nuclearsq.exo_module_strength_4_sqc: Tier IV module for the exo chestplate: +1 melee damage per tier. Only works on the worn piece with a charged Exo Core in your inventory and uses 40 FE per second.
item.nuclearsq.exo_module_strength_5_sqc: Tier V module for the exo chestplate: +1 melee damage per tier. Only works on the worn piece with a charged Exo Core in your inventory and uses 50 FE per second.
item.nuclearsq.exo_module_vein_1_sqc.inf: Module for the exo chestplate: also mines up to 6 connected blocks of the same kind while sneaking, 5 FE per extra block. Only works on the worn piece with a charged Exo Core in your inventory and uses 10 FE per second.
item.nuclearsq.exo_module_vein_2_sqc.inf: Module for the exo chestplate: also mines up to 12 connected blocks of the same kind while sneaking, 5 FE per extra block. Only works on the worn piece with a charged Exo Core in your inventory and uses 20 FE per second.
item.nuclearsq.exo_module_vein_3_sqc.inf: Module for the exo chestplate: also mines up to 24 connected blocks of the same kind while sneaking, 5 FE per extra block. Only works on the worn piece with a charged Exo Core in your inventory and uses 30 FE per second.
item.nuclearsq.exo_module_vein_4_sqc.inf: Module for the exo chestplate: also mines up to 48 connected blocks of the same kind while sneaking, 5 FE per extra block. Only works on the worn piece with a charged Exo Core in your inventory and uses 40 FE per second.
item.nuclearsq.exo_module_vein_5_sqc.inf: Module for the exo chestplate: also mines up to 96 connected blocks of the same kind while sneaking, 5 FE per extra block. Only works on the worn piece with a charged Exo Core in your inventory and uses 50 FE per second.
item.nuclearsq.exo_station_kit_sqc.info: Chamber (2×2×2) for one exo piece: lay the piece inside, charge the Exo Core and install modules. Seen from the front: power on the right, data port on the left. Kit from the Equipment Assembler.
item.nuclearsq.fast_breeder_kit_sqc.info: Fast breeder (9×11×9): a sodium loop with four driver cores and eight breeding blankets. Turns feedwater into wet steam and breeds plutonium from depleted uranium. Needs sodium in the loop. Kit from the Heavy Assembler.
item.nuclearsq.feedwater_bucket_sqc.info: Treated feedwater for the steam generator.
Feedwater heater: preheats feedwater with exhaust steam, which lets the steam generator make 15% more steam. Kit from the Heavy Assembler.
item.nuclearsq.feedwater_pump_kit_sqc.in: Large feedwater pump: pulls at the input and pushes 960 mB/t onwards. Kit from the Heavy Assembler.
item.nuclearsq.filter_residue_sqc.info: Residue from the steam purifier. It radiates even in your inventory: bring it to reprocessing quickly (8 residue give 4 ash, with luck a uranium core) or to the waste repository.
item.nuclearsq.first_wall_tile_sqc.info: Armor of the first wall in the fusion reactor. The reactor swaps it from the item input when the old one is worn out (144,000 ticks at full rate).
item.nuclearsq.fluid_buffer_kit_sqc.info: Fluid buffer (3×3×3): upright tank for any fluid or gas (256000 mB, one kind only). One pipe port in, one out on the opposite side (pushes by itself), plus data. Kit from the Heavy Assembler.
item.nuclearsq.fluorite_cooling_core_sqc: Cooling core made from fluorite and osmium heat plates. Part for the cryo cooling core and the closed cooling tower segment.
item.nuclearsq.fluorite_gem_sqc.info: Crystal from fluorite ore or the particle assembler. Used for the fluorite cooling core and the fluorite moderator.
item.nuclearsq.foundry_kit_sqc.info: Foundry (5×3×4): turns sand and coal into raw silicon and pure silicon into wafers. Kit from the Heavy Assembler.
item.nuclearsq.fuel_cell_kit_sqc.info: Fuel cell (3×3×3): turns 15 mB/t hydrogen and 7 mB/t oxygen into 15000 FE/t of power, without storage. Emergency power for the oxyhydrogen chain. Kit from the heavy assembler.
item.nuclearsq.fuel_rod_block_sqc.mox: MOX load: more power, more heat, more xenon
item.nuclearsq.fuel_rod_block_sqc.spent: Spent: assemble it and put it in the spent fuel rack, or reload it in the reactor assembler
item.nuclearsq.fuel_rod_block_sqc.unload: Unloaded: load it in the reactor assembler with 4 uranium cores or 9 fuel rods
item.nuclearsq.fuel_rod_sqc.info: Fuel filling made from uranium oxide dust and iron. 9 of them make a fuel rod assembly in the reactor assembler.
item.nuclearsq.fusion_reactor_kit_sqc.in: Fusion reactor (21×10×21): tokamak with magnet coils, burns deuterium and tritium, the plasma burns for 10 seconds per ignition. Kit from the heavy assembler.
item.nuclearsq.gas_generator_kit_sqc.inf: Gas generator (5×5×7): gas engine with generator. 6 mB/t ethylene or diesel make 10000 FE/t, without storage. Kit from the Heavy Assembler.
item.nuclearsq.geiger_counter_sqc.info: Measures radiation where you stand, from every source. In your hand a compass needle points to the strongest source within 64 blocks (yellow, orange, red by strength). Right-click shows the value with a rating, in the hotbar it clicks and shows the value above the hotbar. Hold Alt and drag to move the display.
item.nuclearsq.glass_canister_sqc.info: Vitrified high-level waste in a steel cylinder. Strongly radioactive in your inventory, so do not carry it around. Belongs in the waste repository.
item.nuclearsq.glass_plate_sqc.info: A fired glass plate from the Kiln: 2 glass + 1 quartz make 2 plates.
item.nuclearsq.glass_seal_sqc.info: Seal made from glass and clay. Used for fluid ports, pumps, loop blocks and chambers.
item.nuclearsq.glowstone_conductor_sqc.i: Conductor made from refined glowstone and copper coils. Used for the sodium pump, the glowstone translator and the glowstone generator.
item.nuclearsq.gold_dust_sqc.info: Ground gold ore from the Ore Mill (1 ore gives 2 dust). Smelt it into an ingot in a furnace or blast furnace.
item.nuclearsq.gold_plate_sqc.info: A rolled gold ingot from the Plate Mill (1 ingot makes 1 plate).
item.nuclearsq.hammer_mill_kit_sqc.info: Hammer mill (3×2×3): a rotor with hammer bars beats iron, copper and gold ingots into dust: 1 ingot → 1 dust, 25 % chance of a second. Kit from the Small Parts Assembler.
item.nuclearsq.hard_drive_1_sqc.info: Stores up to 4,096 items in 32 kinds. Goes into a server rack and needs 3 FE/t there. The contents stay on the drive even when you take it out. Made in the Small Parts Assembler.
item.nuclearsq.hard_drive_2_sqc.info: Stores up to 16,384 items in 48 kinds. Goes into a server rack and needs 6 FE/t there. The contents stay on the drive even when you take it out. Made in the Soldering Machine.
item.nuclearsq.hard_drive_3_sqc.info: Stores up to 65,536 items in 63 kinds. Goes into a server rack and needs 12 FE/t there. The contents stay on the drive even when you take it out. Made in the Soldering Machine.
item.nuclearsq.hazmat_1_boots_sqc.info: Hazmat suit tier I (yellow) made from leather, wool and a glass pane. Blocks outside radiation and reduces contamination from the ground, wears down in radiation. Base for tier II.
item.nuclearsq.hazmat_1_chestplate_sqc.i: Hazmat suit tier I (yellow) made from leather, wool and a glass pane. Blocks outside radiation and reduces contamination from the ground, wears down in radiation. Base for tier II.
item.nuclearsq.hazmat_1_helmet_sqc.info: Hazmat suit tier I (yellow) made from leather, wool and a glass pane. Blocks outside radiation and reduces contamination from the ground, wears down in radiation. Base for tier II.
item.nuclearsq.hazmat_1_leggings_sqc.inf: Hazmat suit tier I (yellow) made from leather, wool and a glass pane. Blocks outside radiation and reduces contamination from the ground, wears down in radiation. Base for tier II.
item.nuclearsq.hazmat_2_boots_sqc.info: Hazmat suit tier II (orange): a tier I piece with 2 lead shieldings and an HDPE seal and a rubber seal. Blocks outside radiation, but not radiation you carry in your inventory.
item.nuclearsq.hazmat_2_chestplate_sqc.i: Hazmat suit tier II (orange): a tier I piece with 2 lead shieldings and an HDPE seal and a rubber seal. Blocks outside radiation, but not radiation you carry in your inventory.
item.nuclearsq.hazmat_2_helmet_sqc.info: Hazmat suit tier II (orange): a tier I piece with 2 lead shieldings and an HDPE seal and a rubber seal. Blocks outside radiation, but not radiation you carry in your inventory.
item.nuclearsq.hazmat_2_leggings_sqc.inf: Hazmat suit tier II (orange): a tier I piece with 2 lead shieldings and an HDPE seal and a rubber seal. Blocks outside radiation, but not radiation you carry in your inventory.
item.nuclearsq.hazmat_3_boots_sqc.info: Hazmat suit tier III (white): a tier II piece with 2 lead shieldings and an obsidian composite plate. The best protection, only go near a crater with it after an explosion.
item.nuclearsq.hazmat_3_chestplate_sqc.i: Hazmat suit tier III (white): a tier II piece with 2 lead shieldings and an obsidian composite plate. The best protection, only go near a crater with it after an explosion.
item.nuclearsq.hazmat_3_helmet_sqc.info: Hazmat suit tier III (white): a tier II piece with 2 lead shieldings and an obsidian composite plate. The best protection, only go near a crater with it after an explosion.
item.nuclearsq.hazmat_3_leggings_sqc.inf: Hazmat suit tier III (white): a tier II piece with 2 lead shieldings and an obsidian composite plate. The best protection, only go near a crater with it after an explosion.
item.nuclearsq.hdpe_module_casing_sqc.in: Casing for RAM and CPU tiers 5 and 6 and the SSD. CNC mill: 2 HDPE sheets + 1 steel sheet make 2.
item.nuclearsq.hdpe_seal_sqc.info: Better seal made from HDPE and glass seals. Used for feedwater, cooling, sodium parts and the tier II hazmat suit. From the CNC mill.
item.nuclearsq.hdpe_sheet_sqc.info: Plastic from 4 enriched carbon, 2 coal and 1 iron nugget (makes 1). Used for HDPE seals. From the reactor assembler, or 2 from 1 iron nugget and 1,000 mB ethylene in the polymer plant. Ingredient for chip III.
item.nuclearsq.heavy_assembler_kit_sqc.i: Assembly hall with a 5×5 grid for the large recipes: machine kits of the large plants, the large castor and the Create shaft output. Kit from the Reactor Assembler.
item.nuclearsq.heavy_water_cell_sqc.info: Ampoule of heavy water from the heavy water plant. 30 cells, a fluorite moderator and 4 hull plates make the heavy water moderator in the Reactor Assembler.
item.nuclearsq.heavy_water_plant_kit_sqc: Heavy water plant (3×3×3): two exchange towers using the Girdler process. Turns water and sulfur into heavy water, or glass seals and a lot of water into heavy water cells. Kit from the Heavy Assembler.
item.nuclearsq.high_pressure_injection_k: High-pressure injection of the emergency cooling: below 20% pressure, with redstone or in manual mode it feeds up to 320 mB/t of primary water from the relief tank. Kit from the Heavy Assembler.
item.nuclearsq.high_pressure_pump_kit_sq: Machine Kit: High-Pressure Main Coolant Pump
Strong tier of the main coolant pump: pumps 5,120 mB/t of primary water, 9,600 FE/t. Kit from the Heavy Assembler.
item.nuclearsq.hot_coolant_bucket_sqc.in: Heated coolant from the condenser. The cooling tower cools it back down.
item.nuclearsq.intake_pump_kit_sqc.info: Intake pump (9×9×9): a concrete house that reaches four blocks over the water. Its two intake pipes must stand in the water at the bottom, the water is not used up. Delivers 5120 mB/t through two large pipe connections. Kit from the Heavy Assembler.
item.nuclearsq.iodine_tablets_sqc.info: Take them before entering contaminated zones. The dosimeter shows the time left, against outside radiation only distance, shielding or the suit help.
item.nuclearsq.ion_exchanger_kit_sqc.inf: Ion exchanger (3×3×3): resin bed in a side stream of the primary loop, takes deposits and boron out of the reactor. Kit from the Heavy Assembler.
item.nuclearsq.ion_resin_sqc.info: Resin beads for the ion exchanger. One run uses 1 resin and 1,000 mB of primary water and takes 35% deposits and 200 ppm boron out of the reactor.
item.nuclearsq.iron_dust_sqc.info: Ground iron ore from the Ore Mill (1 ore gives 2 dust). Smelt it into an ingot in a furnace or blast furnace.
item.nuclearsq.iron_plate_sqc.info: A rolled iron ingot from the Plate Mill (1 ingot makes 1 plate).
item.nuclearsq.isotope_capsule_sqc.info: Fuel for the radioisotope generator. It only decays while it sits in the generator; the bar shows what is left. A spent capsule stays as material.
item.nuclearsq.isotope_capsule_sqc.tip: %s FE/t in a generator right now, %s %% left
item.nuclearsq.kiln_kit_sqc.info: Kiln (3×3×3): fires coal into coke, zirconium dust into ingots, glass with quartz into glass plates and glass with clay into glass seals. Also smelts everything a furnace smelts with power, ores and clay into bricks included. Kit from the crafting table.
item.nuclearsq.kit.tip1: Right-click the ground: place the machine
item.nuclearsq.kit.tip2: Breaking any part returns the kit (tank contents are lost)
item.nuclearsq.lcp_granulate_sqc.info: Liquid crystal polymer for the first module casings. Chemistry lab: 2 enriched carbon + 250 mB sulfuric acid make 2.
item.nuclearsq.lcp_module_casing_sqc.inf: Casing for RAM and CPU tiers 1 and 2 and the hard drive II. CNC mill: 2 LCP granulate + 1 steel sheet make 2.
item.nuclearsq.leaching_plant_kit_sqc.in: Leaching plant (5×3×4): leaches yellowcake with water and sulfuric acid and gets more uranium oxide out than the centrifuge does. The sludge goes through once more. Kit from the Heavy Assembler.
item.nuclearsq.lead_dust_sqc.info: From the ore mill or from ash in the reprocessing plant. Smelts into a lead ingot.
item.nuclearsq.lead_ingot_sqc.info: Lead for lead shielding, lead blocks and lead glass. From raw lead, lead ore or lead dust in a furnace.
item.nuclearsq.lead_shielding_sqc.info: Lead shielding made from lead and steel sheets. Blocks radiation: goes into the hazmat suit, the steam purifier, the containment, the steam generator and the bombs. From the CNC mill.
item.nuclearsq.link_tool_sqc.info: Right-click a robot arm to select it. Then right-click a block to set the source, Shift + right-click to set a target (chest to chest: one first, the other with Shift). With Shift you can add up to four targets, the arm serves them in turn; Shift + right-click on a set target removes it again. You can also tap the blocks first and the arm afterwards. Shift + right-click on the arm opens its window. Docking for the clean room: select the arm, then Shift + right-click the machine.
item.nuclearsq.lithium_ingot_sqc.info: Lithium for the pellets and wall tiles of the fusion reactor.
item.nuclearsq.lithium_pellet_sqc.info: Breeding material for the blanket of the fusion reactor: one pellet every 150 ticks gives 260 mB of tritium. Made from lithium ingots in the Fuel Pellet Factory.
item.nuclearsq.lubricant_sqc.info: Lithium grease from the chemical lab: 1 lithium ingot and 500 mB diesel give 4 grease. Ingredient of the main coolant pump, high pressure pump and feedwater pump kits.
item.nuclearsq.main_coolant_pump_kit_sqc: Main coolant pump: pumps up to 2,560 mB/t of primary water into the nearest fuel rod drive, 3,600 FE/t. Kit from the Heavy Assembler.
item.nuclearsq.micro_assembler_kit_sqc.i: Small precision workbench (2×2×2) with a soldering arm: makes chip I and the first RAM and CPU tiers in a 3×3 grid. Runs without a computer. Kit from the Small Parts Assembler.
item.nuclearsq.mox_core_sqc.info: Mixed oxide of plutonium oxide and uranium oxide. Loads an empty fuel rod hull as a MOX rod in the Reactor Assembler: 30% more power and 15% more heat, but it poisons 50% faster with xenon. Usually needs a carbon filter.
item.nuclearsq.nano_swarm_canister_sqc.i: A swarm of tiny nano bots as helpers. Right-click opens the radial menu (start and recall, tasks, gadget, settings with radius and four upgrade slots), sneak + right-click changes the task: fell a tree, collect items, mine an ore vein, plant saplings, harvest, till fields, mine stone or decontaminate. The bots work within 24 blocks (the last four only within 12 blocks of you) and deliver everything straight to your inventory; if it is full, the rest drops at your feet. They need an Exo Core somewhere in your inventory, otherwise they shut down and return.
Count upgrade level I: 2 bots instead of one. Every bot works alone on its own target (another block, another trunk, another order block), never two on the same or a neighbouring block; if there are not enough free targets, the other bots wait. Goes into one of the four upgrade slots of the Nano Swarm Canister (right-click the canister). Only the highest level of each type counts.
Count upgrade level II: 4 bots instead of one. Every bot works alone on its own target (another block, another trunk, another order block), never two on the same or a neighbouring block; if there are not enough free targets, the other bots wait. Goes into one of the four upgrade slots of the Nano Swarm Canister (right-click the canister). Only the highest level of each type counts.
Count upgrade level III: 6 bots instead of one. Every bot works alone on its own target (another block, another trunk, another order block), never two on the same or a neighbouring block; if there are not enough free targets, the other bots wait. Goes into one of the four upgrade slots of the Nano Swarm Canister (right-click the canister). Only the highest level of each type counts.
Count upgrade level IV: 8 bots instead of one. Every bot works alone on its own target (another block, another trunk, another order block), never two on the same or a neighbouring block; if there are not enough free targets, the other bots wait. Goes into one of the four upgrade slots of the Nano Swarm Canister (right-click the canister). Only the highest level of each type counts.
Count upgrade level V: 10 bots instead of one. Every bot works alone on its own target (another block, another trunk, another order block), never two on the same or a neighbouring block; if there are not enough free targets, the other bots wait. Goes into one of the four upgrade slots of the Nano Swarm Canister (right-click the canister). Only the highest level of each type counts.
Point upgrade: with the canister in hand, click a block and the bots break it (trees, ore veins and rock masses whole, otherwise the single block). Hold the right mouse button for 1 second: the bots break a 5×5 area across the clicked face. Several clicks are collected as a queue; afterwards the swarm stays out and follows you until you recall it in the radial menu. The target must be within the radius, blocks that need a tool need it in your inventory. Sneak + right-click still switches the task. Goes into one of the four upgrade slots of the Nano Swarm Canister (radial menu, settings).
Reach upgrade level I: the radius in the menu may grow by 8 blocks (near tasks 4). Goes into one of the four upgrade slots of the Nano Swarm Canister (right-click the canister). Only the highest level of each type counts.
Reach upgrade level II: the radius in the menu may grow by 24 blocks (near tasks 12). Goes into one of the four upgrade slots of the Nano Swarm Canister (right-click the canister). Only the highest level of each type counts.
Reach upgrade level III: the radius in the menu may grow by 40 blocks (near tasks 20). Goes into one of the four upgrade slots of the Nano Swarm Canister (right-click the canister). Only the highest level of each type counts.
Reach upgrade level IV: the radius in the menu may grow by 60 blocks (near tasks 30). Goes into one of the four upgrade slots of the Nano Swarm Canister (right-click the canister). Only the highest level of each type counts.
Reach upgrade level V: the radius in the menu may grow by 80 blocks (near tasks 40). Goes into one of the four upgrade slots of the Nano Swarm Canister (right-click the canister). Only the highest level of each type counts.
Speed upgrade level I: bot walking speed, swarm flight, approach and work time x2 (radius, count and reach stay). The minimum work time of hard blocks and the per-tick break budget (config maxBreaksPerTick) limit the effect. Goes into one of the four upgrade slots of the Nano Swarm Canister (right-click the canister). Only the highest level of each type counts.
Speed upgrade level II: bot walking speed, swarm flight, approach and work time x3 (radius, count and reach stay). The minimum work time of hard blocks and the per-tick break budget (config maxBreaksPerTick) limit the effect. Goes into one of the four upgrade slots of the Nano Swarm Canister (right-click the canister). Only the highest level of each type counts.
Speed upgrade level III: bot walking speed, swarm flight, approach and work time x4 (radius, count and reach stay). The minimum work time of hard blocks and the per-tick break budget (config maxBreaksPerTick) limit the effect. Goes into one of the four upgrade slots of the Nano Swarm Canister (right-click the canister). Only the highest level of each type counts.
Speed upgrade level IV: bot walking speed, swarm flight, approach and work time x5 (radius, count and reach stay). The minimum work time of hard blocks and the per-tick break budget (config maxBreaksPerTick) limit the effect. Goes into one of the four upgrade slots of the Nano Swarm Canister (right-click the canister). Only the highest level of each type counts.
Speed upgrade level V: bot walking speed, swarm flight, approach and work time x7 (radius, count and reach stay). The minimum work time of hard blocks and the per-tick break budget (config maxBreaksPerTick) limit the effect. Goes into one of the four upgrade slots of the Nano Swarm Canister (right-click the canister). Only the highest level of each type counts.
item.nuclearsq.neptunium_blanket_sqc.inf: Blanket element with neptunium-237 for the fast breeder (slots 5 to 12 of the item input, like the uranium blanket element). In the neutron flux it turns into a bred neptunium element with plutonium-238.
item.nuclearsq.neptunium_oxide_sqc.info: Neptunium-237 from processing ash (a chance find, about every second batch). With zircaloy and a steel sheet it makes a neptunium blanket element for the fast breeder.
item.nuclearsq.net_scanner_sqc.info: Makes a data network visible, even through walls. Right-click a data cable to pick the network (sneak + right-click works on any part of the network, also on machines and terminals). While the scanner is in your hand, all cables glow cyan, terminals and displays white and every machine in the color of its state (green running, yellow notice, red fault, gray off) with its name. The bright field shows where the cable is attached to the machine. Sneak + right-click in the air forgets the network.
item.nuclearsq.nvme_drive_sqc.info: Stores up to 1,048,576 items in 63 kinds. Goes into a server rack and needs 48 FE/t there. The contents stay on the drive even when you take it out. Made in the Soldering Machine.
item.nuclearsq.obsidian_composite_plate_: Composite plate made from refined obsidian. Used for hardened pressure chambers, pipes, moderators and the tier III hazmat suit. From the CNC mill.
item.nuclearsq.oil_derrick_kit_sqc.info: Oil derrick (2×4×2): pumps 40 mB/t crude oil from an oil well under its floor cells, 450 FE/t. Kit from the Heavy Assembler.
item.nuclearsq.ore_mill_kit_sqc.info: Ore mill: grinds uranium ore into yellowcake and iron, gold or copper ore into twice as much dust. Grinds all other ores too (5 % one extra). Kit from the Heavy Assembler.
item.nuclearsq.osmium_dust_sqc.info: From the ore mill, 2 per ore. Smelts into an osmium ingot.
item.nuclearsq.osmium_heat_plate_sqc.inf: Heat plate made from osmium and steel sheets. Used for heat exchangers, reinforced fuel rod assemblies, cooling tower segments and the reheater. From the CNC mill.
item.nuclearsq.osmium_ingot_sqc.info: Osmium for heat plates and circuits. From raw osmium, osmium ore or osmium dust in a furnace.
item.nuclearsq.overhead_wire_sqc.info: Wire for the overhead line between substations and pylons. A pylon in an unloaded chunk breaks the line.
item.nuclearsq.overhead_wire_sqc.tip: Right-click pylon/substation: start, then the next one: string the wires (1 wire per %s blocks, max %s) · Shift: take wires down
item.nuclearsq.part.tip: Component for machine kits, cannot be placed
item.nuclearsq.particle_assembler_kit_sq: Particle Assembler: brings a blue and a red sphere together, and the flash creates a random raw material from five weight classes. Needs 3,840 FE/t, upgrades change speed, power and yield. Kit from the Heavy Assembler.
Goes into the Particle Assembler's card slot: unlocks every class including exotic (ancient debris, echo shard, netherite scrap). Power 11,520 FE/t. Made from the rare card.
item.nuclearsq.particle_card_heavy_sqc.i: Goes into the Particle Assembler's card slot: unlocks the classes up to heavy (raw iron, raw gold, lapis, obsidian). Power 5760 FE/t. Made from the medium card.
Goes into the Particle Assembler's card slot: unlocks the medium class on top of light (coal, raw copper, redstone, quartz). Power 4,800 FE/t instead of 1280. From the Small Parts Assembler.
item.nuclearsq.particle_card_rare_sqc.in: Goes into the Particle Assembler's card slot: unlocks the classes up to rare (diamond, emerald, uranium, amethyst). Power 7,680 FE/t. Made from the heavy card.
item.nuclearsq.particle_upgrade_efficien: Goes into the Particle Assembler's efficiency slot, up to 8: heavy, rare and exotic classes come up more often, at a little more power.
item.nuclearsq.particle_upgrade_energy_s: Goes into the Particle Assembler's energy slot, up to 8: cuts power use by up to 52%.
item.nuclearsq.particle_upgrade_output_s: Goes into the Particle Assembler's output slot, up to 8: chance of a second batch per run (up to 100%), at more power.
item.nuclearsq.particle_upgrade_speed_sq: Goes into the Particle Assembler's speed slot, up to 8: runs take down to a third of the time, but power use goes up.
item.nuclearsq.pattern_card_sqc.info: Stores a recipe for the Component Assembler. Make blank cards in the Small Parts Assembler, write them in the Component Assembler's menu and put them into one of its 8 card slots. The result can then be ordered at the Storage Terminal.
item.nuclearsq.pattern_rack_kit_sqc.info: Pattern rack (4×5×3) with 40 bays for written pattern cards. Connect power (12 FE/t) and a data cable at the back. All component assemblers and the quantum computer on the same data network see the recipes of the cards and build from them, no card needs to sit in the assembler. Without power, new orders for these cards are blocked, running ones stay valid. Kit from the reactor assembler.
item.nuclearsq.pbt_granulate_sqc.info: Engineering plastic for the middle module casings. Polymer plant: 1 enriched carbon + 250 mB naphtha make 2.
item.nuclearsq.pbt_module_casing_sqc.inf: Casing for RAM and CPU tiers 3 and 4 and the hard drive III. CNC mill: 2 PBT granulate + 1 steel sheet make 2.
item.nuclearsq.pellet_factory_kit_sqc.in: Fuel pellet factory (5×3×4): presses pellets from uranium oxide dust and enriched uranium and sinters them into uranium cores, 1.5 cores per enriched uranium. Kit from the Heavy Assembler.
item.nuclearsq.photoresist_sqc.info: Light-sensitive lacquer from 1 sulfur dust and 250 mB naphtha (makes 4). Ingredient for chip II. From the polymer plant.
item.nuclearsq.plasma_optimizer_sqc.info: Power upgrade for the fusion reactor: drops into the item output on about 5 % of successful ignitions. Placed in the item input it is installed: the ignition costs 5 % more power, the return rises by 5 points. At most 6 (105 % return, 5 % gain).
item.nuclearsq.plate_mill_kit_sqc.info: Plate mill (3×2×3): two counter-rotating rollers press ingots into plates, zircaloy sheets and steel sheets. Kit from the Small Parts Assembler.
item.nuclearsq.plutonium_238_oxide_sqc.i: Heat source for the RTG: Pu-238 gives off decay heat, barely fissile and no use for bombs or MOX. 15 of them make a plutonium capsule with lead shielding and 2 steel sheets.
item.nuclearsq.plutonium_capsule_sqc.inf: Fuel for the radioisotope generator: more than twice the power (9,000 FE/t) of the uranium capsule (3,600 FE/t) and four times the half-life. Only decays while it sits in the generator.
item.nuclearsq.plutonium_capsule_sqc.tip: %s FE/t in a generator right now, %s %% left
item.nuclearsq.plutonium_core_sqc.info: Plutonium core, only from the reprocessing plant (4 plutonium oxide). Driver in the fast breeder and part of the experimental fuel rod assembly.
item.nuclearsq.plutonium_metal_sqc.info: From plutonium oxide in the weapons material plant. 2 of them make a weapons plutonium core.
item.nuclearsq.plutonium_oxide_sqc.info: Powder from bred elements. 4 of them make a plutonium core in reprocessing, or plutonium metal in the weapons material plant.
A carried battery for robotics: 16,000,000 FE. In your inventory it recharges the Exo Core whenever the core runs short for the nano bots. It never feeds the grid. Charges with any charger that writes FE into items.
item.nuclearsq.pocket_battery_medium_sqc: A carried battery for robotics: 4,000,000 FE. In your inventory it recharges the Exo Core whenever the core runs short for the nano bots. It never feeds the grid. Charges with any charger that writes FE into items.
A carried battery for robotics: 1,000,000 FE. In your inventory it recharges the Exo Core whenever the core runs short for the nano bots. It never feeds the grid. Charges with any charger that writes FE into items.
item.nuclearsq.polycarbonate_granulate_s: Clear, heat resistant plastic for the highest module casings. Polymer plant: 2 PBT granulate + 500 mB ethylene make 1.
item.nuclearsq.polycarbonate_module_casi: Casing for RAM and CPU tiers 7 and 8. CNC mill: 2 polycarbonate granulate + 1 steel sheet make 2.
item.nuclearsq.polymer_plant_kit_sqc.inf: Polymer plant (3×3×3): horizontal vulcanizing kettle with a roller. Turns slime or kelp, sulfur and water into rubber, and rubber into seals and ion resin. Tar from the column makes rubber and sealing compound, naphtha photoresist, ethylene HDPE sheet. Coal and tar make coke. Kit from the Heavy Assembler.
item.nuclearsq.preheated_feedwater_bucke: Preheated feedwater from the feedwater heater, for the steam generator.
item.nuclearsq.pressurizer_kit_sqc.info: Pressurizer (3×8×3): holds the primary loop at 155 bar, heats with power and vents into the relief tank above 90%. Kit from the Heavy Assembler.
item.nuclearsq.progression_book_sqc.info: The mod's reference book: right-click to open chapters on every machine, all recipes, the road to power and the progress tree.
item.nuclearsq.quantum_capacity_upgrade_: Put it in the top upgrade slot of the Quantum Chest: twice the slots per upgrade, up to 2 (32, 64, 128). Takes effect the next time you open it. It can only be removed while the extra slots are empty.
Quantum computer (5×4×5): autocrafting like the component assembler, but 1,024 parts per second. Only runs with full computing power in the data network: 320 CPU and 5,120 GB (about 10 computing clusters). Power: 855,000 FE/t.
item.nuclearsq.quantum_magnet_upgrade_sq: Put it in the middle upgrade slot of the Quantum Chest: the placed chest pulls in loose items within 6 blocks as long as there is room.
item.nuclearsq.quantum_module_sqc.info: Part of the quantum computer (controller and kit). Has no function of its own. Made in the small parts assembler.
item.nuclearsq.quantum_sorter_upgrade_sq: Put it in the bottom upgrade slot of the Quantum Chest: when you close the window, equal stacks are merged and everything is ordered by item ID.
item.nuclearsq.ram_module_1gb_sqc.info: Adds 4 GB of memory to the data network, but no CPU cores. Goes into a bay of a server rack and needs 3 FE/t there. There are eight tiers from 1 GB to 128 GB. Each GB lets the Component Assembler take 16 more parts in one order. It does not add storage space to the drives. Several sticks add up. Made in the Soldering Machine from the stick one tier below plus extra parts.
item.nuclearsq.ram_module_256mb_sqc.info: Adds 1 GB of memory to the data network, but no CPU cores. Goes into a bay of a server rack and needs 3 FE/t there. There are eight tiers from 1 GB to 128 GB. Each GB lets the Component Assembler take 16 more parts in one order. It does not add storage space to the drives. Several sticks add up. Made in the Small Parts Assembler from the stick one tier below plus extra parts.
item.nuclearsq.ram_module_2gb_sqc.info: Adds 8 GB of memory to the data network, but no CPU cores. Goes into a bay of a server rack and needs 3 FE/t there. There are eight tiers from 1 GB to 128 GB. Each GB lets the Component Assembler take 16 more parts in one order. It does not add storage space to the drives. Several sticks add up. Made in the Soldering Machine from the stick one tier below plus extra parts.
item.nuclearsq.ram_module_32gb_sqc.info: Adds 128 GB of memory to the data network, but no CPU cores. Goes into a bay of a server rack and needs 12 FE/t there. There are eight tiers from 1 GB to 128 GB. Each GB lets the Component Assembler take 16 more parts in one order. It does not add storage space to the drives. Several sticks add up. Made in the Small Parts Assembler from the stick one tier below plus extra parts.
item.nuclearsq.ram_module_4gb_sqc.info: Adds 16 GB of memory to the data network, but no CPU cores. Goes into a bay of a server rack and needs 3 FE/t there. There are eight tiers from 1 GB to 128 GB. Each GB lets the Component Assembler take 16 more parts in one order. It does not add storage space to the drives. Several sticks add up. Made in the Soldering Machine from the stick one tier below plus extra parts.
item.nuclearsq.ram_module_512mb_sqc.info: Adds 2 GB of memory to the data network, but no CPU cores. Goes into a bay of a server rack and needs 3 FE/t there. There are eight tiers from 1 GB to 128 GB. Each GB lets the Component Assembler take 16 more parts in one order. It does not add storage space to the drives. Several sticks add up. Made in the Small Parts Assembler from the stick one tier below plus extra parts.
item.nuclearsq.ram_module_8gb_sqc.info: Adds 32 GB of memory to the data network, but no CPU cores. Goes into a bay of a server rack and needs 6 FE/t there. There are eight tiers from 1 GB to 128 GB. Each GB lets the Component Assembler take 16 more parts in one order. It does not add storage space to the drives. Several sticks add up. Made in the Small Parts Assembler from the stick one tier below plus extra parts.
item.nuclearsq.ram_module_sqc.info: Adds 64 GB of memory to the data network, but no CPU cores. Goes into a bay of a server rack and needs 6 FE/t there. There are eight tiers from 1 GB to 128 GB. Each GB lets the Component Assembler take 16 more parts in one order. It does not add storage space to the drives. Several sticks add up. Made in the Small Parts Assembler from the stick one tier below plus extra parts.
item.nuclearsq.raw_lead_sqc.info: From lead ore or the particle assembler. Smelts into a lead ingot, the ore mill makes twice as much dust.
item.nuclearsq.raw_lithium_sqc.info: Raw lithium from lithium ore. Smelts to a lithium ingot.
item.nuclearsq.raw_osmium_sqc.info: From osmium ore or the particle assembler. Smelts into an osmium ingot, the ore mill makes twice as much dust.
item.nuclearsq.raw_tin_sqc.info: From tin ore or the particle assembler. Smelts into a tin ingot, the ore mill makes twice as much dust.
item.nuclearsq.raw_uranium_sqc.info: From uranium ore or the particle assembler. The ore mill turns it into 2 yellowcake, which becomes fuel.
item.nuclearsq.reactor_assembler_kit_sqc: The first machine: makes plates, seals, cores, boards and the first kits in a 3×3 grid. Needs 1,350 FE/t while working (reactor parts 3,840 FE/t). Kit from the Small Parts Assembler.
item.nuclearsq.reactor_plate_sqc.info: The basic plate of the mod, made from iron sheets. Goes into fuel rod assemblies, pressure chambers, casings, moderators and many parts.
item.nuclearsq.refined_glowstone_ingot_s: 4 glowstone dust + 1 osmium ingot. Used for glowstone conductors. From the Blast Furnace.
item.nuclearsq.refined_obsidian_ingot_sq: 2 etched obsidian, 1 diamond, 1 osmium ingot make 2 ingots in the small parts assembler. Used for obsidian composite plates.
item.nuclearsq.reheater_kit_sqc.info: Reheater: turns steam into superheated steam, which gives the turbine 20% more power. Needs no power. Kit from the Heavy Assembler.
item.nuclearsq.relief_tank_kit_sqc.info: Wetwell: turns steam of any kind into water, as a reserve for the emergency cooling. Kit from the Heavy Assembler.
item.nuclearsq.reprocessing_plant_kit_sq: Reprocessing plant: turns filter residue and cooled spent fuel into uranium oxide dust, ash, enriched uranium and plutonium oxide. Kit from the Heavy Assembler.
item.nuclearsq.respirator_filter_iodine_: Filter for the respirator mask with an iodine effect: filters like the respirator filter and, as long as it lasts, also cuts the uptake of contamination into the body and its inner radiation by 70 %, like an iodine tablet. Lasts 10 minutes of polluted air, inserted like the respirator filter.
item.nuclearsq.respirator_filter_sqc.inf: Replacement filter for the respirator mask, lasts 10 minutes of polluted air. Right-click puts it into the worn mask, or drag it onto the mask in your inventory. A new filter can only be inserted once the old one is used up.
item.nuclearsq.respirator_mask_sqc.info: Breathing mask for the helmet slot. With a filter inserted it blocks 60 % of the dust from the ground and fallout and 95 % of the steam at leaks; the filter only runs down in polluted air. Drag a filter onto the mask in your inventory or right-click with the filter in hand. It hardly helps against outside radiation, in a hazmat suit it counts as half a helmet.
item.nuclearsq.robo_ball_sqc.info: Right-click throws the ball. Your robo dog runs after it, carries it in its mouth and brings it back into your inventory. The ball never despawns.
item.nuclearsq.robo_cat_kit_sqc.info: Right-click the ground to place the robo cat. It follows you; right-click with an empty hand pets it, Shift + right-click makes it sit or follow again. It brings you items from the ground nearby and plays with the feather wand. Battery 200,000 FE: when empty it lies down; charge it by right-clicking with a battery item, or next to a power source or the Exo Station. Shift + right-click with the wrench turns it back into the kit.
item.nuclearsq.robo_collar_lamp_sqc.info: For dog and cat. Right-click your pet to put it on. The pet glows and lights up its surroundings (light 12).
item.nuclearsq.robo_collar_sniffer_sqc.i: Robo dog only. Right-click your dog to put it on. When it finds raised radiation it runs to the strongest source, stays there for 5 seconds and barks, then follows you again (30 seconds pause afterwards).
item.nuclearsq.robo_collar_tidy_sqc.info: Robo cat only. First right-click a chest with the module, then your cat. It puts its finds into that chest (up to 32 blocks away) instead of bringing them to you. If the chest is full it brings them to you.
item.nuclearsq.robo_dog_kit_sqc.info: Right-click the ground to place the robo dog. It follows you; right-click with an empty hand pets it, Shift + right-click makes it sit or follow again. Its sniffer warns you of dangerous radiation, and it fetches the toy ball. Battery 200,000 FE: when empty it lies down; charge it by right-clicking with a battery item, or next to a power source or the Exo Station. Shift + right-click with the wrench turns it back into the kit.
item.nuclearsq.robo_feather_wand_sqc.inf: Right-click (or hold it) makes the feather dance. Your robo cat within 8 blocks crouches, stalks, pounces at the feather and hops back.
item.nuclearsq.robot_arm_upgrade_sqc.inf: Goes into one of the four upgrade slots in the robot arm's window. Each upgrade raises the amount per move by one step: 1, 4, 16, 32, 64 items.
item.nuclearsq.rubber_seal_sqc.info: Seal made from 3 rubber and a glass seal (2 pieces) in the polymer plant. For the tier II hazmat suit and the respirator mask.
item.nuclearsq.rubber_sqc.info: Vulcanized rubber from the polymer plant (slime ball or kelp with sulfur and water). Insulates the hardened power cables and goes into rubber seals and ion resin.
item.nuclearsq.server_rack_kit_sqc.info: Server Rack (2×4×2) with 12 hard drive bays. Connect power and a data cable at the back: 24 FE/t plus the power of the drives. Without power the items stay on the drives but cannot be reached. Kit from the Heavy Assembler, made from two small rack kits.
item.nuclearsq.server_rack_large_kit_sqc: Large Server Rack (4×5×3) with 40 hard drive bays. Connect power and a data cable at the back: 24 FE/t plus the power of the drives. Without power the items stay on the drives but cannot be reached. Kit from the Heavy Assembler, made from two rack kits.
item.nuclearsq.server_rack_small_kit_sqc: Small Server Rack (1×3×2) with 6 hard drive bays. Connect power and a data cable at the back: 24 FE/t plus the power of the drives. the items stay on the drives but cannot be reached. Kit from the Small Parts Assembler.
item.nuclearsq.shaft_generator_kit_sqc.i: Shaft generator behind the turbine's shaft coupling: turns shaft power into up to 160,000 FE/t. Kit from the Heavy Assembler.
item.nuclearsq.silicon_pure_sqc.info: Cleaned silicon from the chemical lab (3 raw silicon and 300 mB sulfuric acid make 2). Becomes wafers in the foundry and goes into chip II and III.
item.nuclearsq.silicon_raw_sqc.info: Gray silicon from the foundry (4 sand and 1 coal make 2). Must be cleaned with sulfuric acid in the chemical lab.
item.nuclearsq.silicon_wafer_sqc.info: Thin silicon disc from the foundry (2 pure silicon make 4). Base of chip I.
item.nuclearsq.slag_crusher_kit_sqc.info: Waste crusher (3×3×3): grinds nuclear ash and filter residue into lead and zirconium dust, sometimes with neptunium oxide. Kit from the Heavy Assembler.
item.nuclearsq.small_parts_assembler_kit: Precision workbench (3×2×3) with soldering iron and placement arm: makes the electronics for the storage system in a 3×3 grid. Needs 960 FE/t while working. Kit from the crafting table.
item.nuclearsq.sodium_coolant_bucket_sqc: Strong coolant (factor 1.6) from the high-pressure pump up, also for the circulation pump and high-pressure pump.
item.nuclearsq.solar_field_kit_sqc.info: Solar field made of 4 solar panels: up to 2400 FE/t by day, needs open sky above the center. Kit from the Heavy Assembler.
item.nuclearsq.solder_machine_kit_sqc.in: Soldering Machine (2×2×3): wave soldering line with a soldering head and fume extractor, solders chip II, CPU and RAM modules and hard drives. Kit from the Small Parts Assembler.
item.nuclearsq.solid_state_drive_sqc.inf: Stores up to 262,144 items in 63 kinds. Goes into a server rack and needs 24 FE/t there. The contents stay on the drive even when you take it out. Made in the Soldering Machine.
item.nuclearsq.spent_fuel_rack_kit_sqc.i: Spent fuel rack for spent fuel rods in a water pool you build yourself: after about 5 minutes they become cooled spent fuel. Kit from the Heavy Assembler.
item.nuclearsq.spent_fuel_sqc.info: Cooled spent fuel from the spent fuel rack. Reprocessing turns it into uranium oxide dust, ash and sometimes plutonium oxide, or it goes into the waste repository.
item.nuclearsq.spent_resin_sqc.info: Weakly radioactive waste from the ion exchanger. Belongs in the repository.
item.nuclearsq.steam_dryer_kit_sqc.info: Dries wet steam after the separator: 40 become 39 steam and 1 water. Kit from the Heavy Assembler.
item.nuclearsq.steam_generator_kit_sqc.i: Steam generator of the pressurized water reactor: hot primary water from the fuel rod drive gives off its heat and turns feedwater into wet steam, the primary water goes back cold. Kit from the Heavy Assembler.
item.nuclearsq.steam_purifier_kit_sqc.in: Large steam purifier: cleans 1,280 mB/t of contaminated steam, one filter residue per 512,000 mB. Kit from the Heavy Assembler.
item.nuclearsq.steam_separator_kit_sqc.i: Separates wet steam from the steam generator: 40 become 36 steam and 4 water. Kit from the Heavy Assembler.
item.nuclearsq.steel_ingot_sqc.info: In the small parts assembler 1 iron ingot + 1 coal make one steel ingot, in the blast furnace 8 iron ingots + 8 coal (slot 5) make eight at once.
item.nuclearsq.steel_sheet_sqc.info: Steel sheet made from steel ingots (7 ingots in the plate mill or the small parts assembler). The most common part: controllers, ports, instruments, protective gear and bombs all need it.
item.nuclearsq.storage_crate_upgrade_1_s: Capacity upgrade for the storage crate: 54 instead of 27 slots. Put it into the upgrade slot on the right of the window, the crate then opens in its new size.
item.nuclearsq.storage_crate_upgrade_2_s: Capacity upgrade for the storage crate: 108 instead of 27 slots. Only one upgrade fits; it only comes out if the contents fit into the smaller crate.
item.nuclearsq.strontium_capsule_sqc.inf: Fuel for the radioisotope generator: 6,400 FE/t and twice the half-life of the uranium capsule (3,600 FE/t). Making it relieves the repository because there is less liquid waste. Only decays while it sits in the generator.
item.nuclearsq.strontium_capsule_sqc.tip: %s FE/t in a generator right now, %s %% left
item.nuclearsq.strontium_cesium_sqc.info: Fission products Sr-90 and Cs-137 separated from the high-level liquid waste: the vitrification plant turns 2 ion resin, 300 mB liquid waste and 200 mB nitric acid into one concentrate (the resin comes back spent). Strongly radioactive. Four of them make a strontium capsule with lead shielding and a steel sheet.
item.nuclearsq.substation_kit_sqc.info: Substation (5×5×5): start and end of the overhead line. Takes up to 2 × 131,072 FE/t at the front, shares it over the wires with every substation on the grid and hands it straight to cables and machines at four power outputs (FE and RF), with Create: Power Grid also to a grid terminal. Kit from the Heavy Assembler.
item.nuclearsq.sulfur_dust_sqc.info: Sulfur from roasting iron, copper or lead ore in the acid plant, as a by-product of the distillation column or from nether sulfur ore. With sulfur dust and water it makes sulfuric acid there.
Sulfuric acid for the leaching plant. Right-click the acid port to fill the tank, a pipe works too. Made from a coolant bucket, gunpowder and an HDPE seal in the Reactor Assembler.
Magnet coil of the fusion reactor: holds the plasma in the torus. A part for controller and kit.
item.nuclearsq.survey_drone_sqc.info: Right-click a block to put the drone down. Bind it with the survey tablet, mark a zone and send it off: it flies over the zone at 4 blocks height, measures the dose rate at the ground every 2 blocks and lands at its start spot again. Battery 40,000 FE, charges at its start spot next to a power source. Shift + right-click with both hands empty picks it up.
item.nuclearsq.survey_tablet_sqc.info: Handheld with a screen for the survey drone. Right-click the drone to bind it. Shift + right-click two blocks to mark the zone (up to 64 x 64). Shift + right-click the air or the drone sends it off or calls it back. Right-click the air shows the radiation map. In the map window, “Fly yourself” lets you steer the drone from its own view.
item.nuclearsq.tin_dust_sqc.info: From the ore mill, 2 per ore. Smelts into a tin ingot.
item.nuclearsq.tin_ingot_sqc.info: Tin for zircaloy sheets. From raw tin, tin ore or tin dust in a furnace.
item.nuclearsq.turbine_kit_sqc.info: Steam turbine: turns clean steam into power, up to 400 mB/t and 102,400 FE/t. Start/stop and throttle in the terminal. Kit from the Reactor Assembler.
item.nuclearsq.uf6_converter_kit_sqc.inf: UF6 conversion plant (5×4×4): turns uranium oxide and fluorite or hydrofluoric acid into UF6 cylinders for the centrifuge. Needs power and fluorite in the extra slot or hydrofluoric acid at the hydrofluoric acid port. Kit from the Heavy Assembler.
item.nuclearsq.uf6_cylinder_sqc.info: Uranium hexafluoride in a transport cylinder, from the UF6 conversion plant. The centrifuge turns it into 2 enriched and 1 depleted uranium, more than yellowcake gives.
item.nuclearsq.ultimate_circuit_sqc.info: 2 elite circuits, 2 refined obsidian ingots, 1 precision chip (chip II), 1 netherite scrap. Goes into control board III. From the Small Parts Assembler.
item.nuclearsq.uranium_core_sqc.info: Fuel core made from enriched uranium in zircaloy. 15 cores fill one fuel rod casing, and they go into the bombs.
item.nuclearsq.uranium_fragment_sqc.info: A raw piece of uranium. Smelt it or grind it into yellowcake in the Ore Mill.
item.nuclearsq.uranium_oxide_dust_sqc.in: Made from 4 uranium oxide in the Ore Mill. Also comes out of reprocessing cooled spent fuel.
item.nuclearsq.uranium_oxide_sqc.info: An intermediate fuel stage, made as a by-product of the centrifuge. Can be crushed into uranium oxide dust.
item.nuclearsq.uranium_pellet_sqc.info: Pressed uranium oxide pellet from the fuel pellet factory. Two pellets make one uranium core in the sintering furnace.
item.nuclearsq.uranium_sludge_sqc.info: Leftover of leaching. Three sludge go through the leaching plant once more with water and acid and make uranium oxide.
item.nuclearsq.vitrification_plant_kit_s: Vitrification plant (3×3×3): dissolves filter residue and spent resin in sulfuric acid into high-level liquid waste and melts it with sand into glass canisters. Kit from the Heavy Assembler.
Waste repository: takes spent rods, cooled spent fuel, filter residue and fallout for good. Kit from the Heavy Assembler.
item.nuclearsq.water_treatment_kit_sqc.i: Large water treatment: turns 1,280 mB/t of water into feedwater. Kit from the Heavy Assembler.
item.nuclearsq.weapons_plutonium_core_sq: A sphere of weapons-grade plutonium, only from the weapons material plant. Trigger core of the Large Nuclear Bomb, four of them go into the Tsar Bomba.
item.nuclearsq.weapons_processing_kit_sq: Weapons material plant (7×4×5): turns plutonium oxide into plutonium metal and that into weapons plutonium cores for the bombs. Radiates while running and needs a lot of power. Kit from the Heavy Assembler.
item.nuclearsq.wifi_antenna_dish_sqc.inf: Stage 4 of the Wi-Fi adapter: directional dish, range 4,096 blocks. Only fits after the sector antenna. Drops out again when the adapter is broken.
Last stage of the Wi-Fi adapter: unlimited range, even from other dimensions. The chunk of the adapter and the racks must be loaded for that. Only fits after the directional dish module. Drops out again when the adapter is broken.
item.nuclearsq.wifi_antenna_sector_sqc.i: Stage 3 of the Wi-Fi adapter: three sector antennas around the mast, range 1,024 blocks. Only fits once two antenna modules are in. Drops out again when the adapter is broken.
item.nuclearsq.wifi_antenna_sqc.info: Stage 1 and 2 of the Wi-Fi adapter: right-click the adapter to extend its range to 128 and 320 blocks. Sector antenna, directional dish and quantum antenna follow. Drops out again when the adapter is broken.
item.nuclearsq.wifi_terminal_sqc.info: Crafting terminal on the go. Right-click a Wi-Fi adapter to link it, then right-click within the adapter's range to open the terminal of the storage network. Battery 40,000 FE: opening costs 100 FE, every crafted recipe 20 FE. Charge it in the adapter's charging field or with any charger. Sneak + right-click removes the link.
item.nuclearsq.wind_turbine_large_kit_sq: Wind Power Plant (35×72×14): power from wind, up to 7,040 FE/t depending on height, open surroundings and weather. No storage: power nobody takes is lost. Kit from the Heavy Assembler.
item.nuclearsq.wind_turbine_medium_kit_s: Wind Turbine (17×36×7): power from wind, up to 1760 FE/t depending on height, open surroundings and weather. No storage: power nobody takes is lost. Kit from the Heavy Assembler.
item.nuclearsq.wind_turbine_small_kit_sq: Small Wind Turbine (7×14×5): power from wind, up to 352 FE/t depending on height, open surroundings and weather. No storage: power nobody takes is lost. Kit from the Heavy Assembler.
item.nuclearsq.worn_wall_tile_sqc.info: Used wall tile, activated by neutrons and radioactive. Belongs in the repository.
item.nuclearsq.wrench_sqc.info: Takes finished machines apart: Shift + right-click any part and the kit drops. With Shift it also breaks pipes and cables directly.
item.nuclearsq.wrench_sqc.tip: Right-click pipe/cable: toggle side · Shift: dismantle
item.nuclearsq.wrench_sqc.tip_outline: Right click into the air: outline on/off
item.nuclearsq.yellowcake_sqc.info: Ground uranium ore from the Ore Mill. 2 yellowcake make 1 enriched uranium in the Enrichment Centrifuge.
item.nuclearsq.zircaloy_sheet_sqc.info: Cladding material for fuel: goes into the uranium core, the fuel rod casing, the steam generator and the coolants.
item.nuclearsq.zircon_sqc.info: Crystal from zircon ore or the particle assembler. In the reactor assembler 1 zircon becomes 4 zirconium dust.
item.nuclearsq.zirconium_dust_sqc.info: Base material for zirconium: 4 diamonds + 15 quartz or 4 zircon make 4 dust in the Reactor Assembler. 8 dust make one ingot in the kiln.
item.nuclearsq.zirconium_ingot_sqc.info: Zirconium for zircaloy sheets: 4 ingots + 8 tin in the plate mill make 2 sheets. Made from 8 dust in the kiln.
jei.nuclearsq.particle.share: Share per run: %s %% (without upgrades and cards)
key.nuclearsq.vein_mine: Vein miner (hold to break connected blocks)
logbook.nuclearsq.start: Logbook running, %s plants on the network

tooltip.nuclearsq.group.chemistry:
Uranium processing from acid to fuel rod, reactor chemistry,
reprocessing, oil and gas.
tooltip.nuclearsq.group.computing:
Chip making, data network and control room, digital storage,
bank and auction house.
tooltip.nuclearsq.group.energy:
Power sources: coal, solar, wind and RTG.
Lines: pipes, cables, batteries, overhead line and substation.
tooltip.nuclearsq.group.manufacturing:
Compendium, wrench and assemblers, ore and metal, device modules,
building parts, controllers and ports. At the end the future chest and creative sources.
tooltip.nuclearsq.group.protection:
Hazmat suit, dosimeter, sprayer and shower.
Geiger counter, radiation sensors and medicine against radiation.
tooltip.nuclearsq.group.reactor:
Fuel rod hulls and dockers, the loop from rod drive to turbine,
spent fuel, breeder and repository. At the end the fusion reactor.
tooltip.nuclearsq.group.robotics:
Robot arms, gripper, nanobots, decon robot, robo pets and drone.
Plus exo station, exo armor and exo modules.
tooltip.nuclearsq.group.weapons:
Weapons processing, plutonium metal and weapons core,
the three nuclear bombs and the detonator.
tooltip.nuclearsq.iodine_tablets: Right-click: take one tablet. For 5 minutes 70 % less contamination gets into your body (ground, air, food). Does not help against radiation from outside.
tooltip.nuclearsq.medicine: Drink: lowers your dose by 3 Sv, then for 2 minutes it rises only half as fast.
